The target's thoughts flood with irrelevant and confusing information, causing it to become {@condition stupefied|PC1|stupefied 1} if it fails a Will save (or {@condition stupefied|PC1|stupefied 2} on a critical failure).

name: Unravel Knowledge
entries: Your patron reaches into the target's mind, plucking out their past training like pulling a thread from a cloth. Choose a single action, activity, or spell you know the target can use, such as from seeing it previously or identifying the creature's capabilities with a {@action Recall Knowledge} check. You could select, for example, the {@action Strike} action, the {@action Disarm} action, a dragon's breath, or the {@spell haste|PC1} spell if you were aware the target could use them. The target attempts a Will save.

Success: The target is unaffected.
Failure: The target's memories of their ability grow foggy. The first time they use the chosen ability each round, they take {@damage 3d8} mental damage. This ability is less effective if you choose an ability almost anyone can use; the target takes {@damage 3d4} mental damage instead if you choose a basic action (such as {@action Strike}, {@action Stride}, or {@action Raise a Shield}) or a skill action that can be used untrained (such as {@action Demoralize} or {@action Hide}).
Critical Failure: As failure, and the target takes a –2 status penalty to any check or DC for the ability the first time they use it each round.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, or by {@dice 1d4} for a basic action or untrained skill action.

name: Censure Falsehoods
entries: You call on your patron to reprimand a creature that has attempted a {@skill Deception} or {@skill Stealth} check against you or an ally within the past month. You must be aware they did so. Whenever the target speaks, toads and serpents fall from their lips. The target attempts a Fortitude saving throw. The spell lasts as long as the target remains {@condition sickened} by it.

Critical Success: A few animals fall from their lips, but they're otherwise unaffected.
Success: The target is {@condition sickened||sickened 1}.
Failure: The target is {@condition sickened||sickened 2} and if they perform an action that has the {@trait auditory} trait or attempt to {@action Cast a Spell}, they must succeed at a DC {@flatDC 5} flat check, or the action is disrupted as they choke on an animal.
Critical Failure: As failure, and if the target attempts a {@skill Deception} or {@skill Stealth} check, their {@condition sickened} value increases by 1 (to a maximum of {@condition sickened||sickened 4}).

name: Halcyon Mists
entries: In a moment of dire need, you call upon ancestral power to strengthen and sustain. A soothing mist gathers around the target, granting {@dice 1d8} temporary Hit Points and ending one source of {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent acid, bleed, fire, poison, or void damage} affecting it. If the creature has {@condition persistent damage|PC1} from more than one of these sources, you choose the one that ends.
The mists linger around the target, making them {@condition concealed|PC1} until the beginning of their next turn, though this obvious concealment can't be used to {@action Hide|PC1}.

1: The temporary Hit Points increase by {@dice 1d8}.

name: Call the Ten
entries: The Ten Magic Warriors were the first of the Magaambya's students, and they come to your aid even now. An indistinct spirit appears near each target, each wearing a different mask of the Ten Magic Warriors. The spirits then either strike their designated targets with magical energy, dealing each one {@damage 4d6} spirit damage with a basic Fortitude save, or shield them, granting their target resistance 3 to physical and spirit damage until the beginning of your next turn. You designate which targets are attacked and which are shielded.

2: The amount of damage increases by {@damage 1d6} and the amount of resistance increases by 2.

name: Domora's Defense
entries: Domora Hume is considered by most to be the first god caller, conjuring a god from the Plane of Water named Dyzad to protect his town from Mammoth Lord raiders. A lost story of this defense claims that Dyzad appeared to be in three places at once, blocking the raiders' spears, swords, and torches. The intended lesson is that Dyzad will overcome any barrier to protect the people of Sarkoris. This spell gives that intention physical form, allowing the caster to protect their people.

When you Cast this Spell, a watery replica of the eidolon Dyzad appears in front of each of the targets, granting them a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and fire resistance 5. While the replica persists, a target can use the {@feat Shield Block|PC1} reaction with the replica. The replica has Hardness 15 (or Hardness 20 against fire damage). They can use this reaction to reduce damage from any spell or {@trait magical} effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After a target uses {@feat Shield Block|PC1}, the replica dissipates. The spell ends when you no longer {@action Sustain|PC1} it or if all three replicas have dissipated, whichever happens first.

name: The Four Hunters
entries: This is a story of four evenly matched hunters who sought to capture a falling star. Each hunter was known by the region they came from, and this spell focuses on one of their attributes. When you cast this spell, you must choose East, North, South, or West.

items: {@b East} was steady and optimistic. The target gains 5 temporary Hit Points and a +1 status bonus to {@skill Athletics|PC1} for 1 round.
{@b North} was careful and cautious. The target can {@action Step|PC1} as a free action and gains a +1 status bonus to {@skill Survival|PC1} for 1 round.
{@b South} was clever and cunning. The target becomes {@condition concealed|PC1} and gains a +1 status bonus to {@skill Stealth|PC1} for 1 round.
{@b West} was bold and competitive. The target gains a +10-foot status bonus to their land Speed and a +1 status bonus to {@skill Acrobatics|PC1} for 1 round.

items.name: {@as 1}
entries: You quickly remind yourself of the story, granting only yourself the benefit.

items.name: {@as 2}
entries: You tell a trusted ally within 30 feet this story, granting them the benefit.

items.name: {@as 3}
entries: You impart this tale on all of your allies within 30 feet, granting them the benefit.

name: Ibex's Harvest
entries: In the tale "Ibex's Harvest," Ibex turns from the path of a warrior to the path of a farmer, building up their community by working hard and sharing a bountiful harvest not just with their humanoid neighbors but also with their animal neighbors. Ibex initially focuses on distributing equally among the animals but learns that true equality requires knowing what each being needs. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell and telling the story determine its targets and effects.

items.name: {@as 1}
entries: You give a brief description of Ibex's first bounty. One willing target you can touch gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last 1 minute.

items.name: {@as 2}
entries: You tell the tale of how Ibex shared their harvest equally between Hippo and Ant. Two willing targets within 20 feet each gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last 1 minute.

items.name: {@as 3}
entries: You impart Ibex's lesson about how to prevent others from taking advantage of generosity. All creatures within a 10-foot emanation are affected by the tale. Choose one creature in the emanation to take {@damage 2d8} mental damage (basic Will save), while each other creature in the emanation gains 5 temporary Hit Points that last 1 minute.

1: The temporary Hit Points increase by 3 and the mental damage for the 3-action version increases by {@damage 1d8}.

name: Kgalaserke's Axes
entries: The folklore and tales surrounding the legendary hero Kgalaserke are so widespread and well known that a hundred lifetimes would not be enough to have accomplished everything she is reputed to have done. Nevertheless, the stories all contain a unifying theme of her martial prowess despite the odds being stacked against her.

items.name: {@as 1}
entries: You briefly describe Kgalaserke's signature axes and how she came to receive them. The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls for the spell's duration.

items.name: {@as 2}
entries: You revel in a tale of Kgalaserke striking down a foe after a struggle. For the spell's duration, when the target is damaged by a creature's attack, the target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to damage against that target for 1 round.

name: The Parrot's Whisper
entries: You call forth an echo of the gossiping parrot from the tale of the Witch and the Weaver to whisper the secrets of a creature you can see within range. The garrulous parrot is known to chatter on for some time while deciphering the information you seek. The target must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success: The parrot chatters about various random topics for 1 round and reveals no relevant information.
Success: The parrot tells you the target's highest weakness at the start of your next turn. In the meantime, the parrot chatters about various random topics.
Failure: The parrot tells you the target's highest weakness immediately, but sticks around for 1 round to chatter.
Critical Failure: The parrot tells you the target's highest weakness immediately, and you can ask the parrot one question. You might need to collaborate with the GM to narrow down the question. At the start of your next turn, the parrot answers the question truthfully.

name: The Queen's Rainbow
entries: You tell the story of the Queen of Bees and her retinue trying to pass through a rainbow on their way to visit the King of Spiders. You conjure forth a large, transparent rainbow. Creatures who enter or begin their turn in the rainbow's space must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or become {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 round (or {@condition blinded|PC1} for 1 round on a critical failure).

name: Ranage's Circle
entries: Many stories tell of a clearing deep in the Mwangi jungle, surrounded by ancient cypress trees. At the center stands an ancient baobab tree growing around a large sphere of black basalt. Legends say that two spirit brothers, Ranage and Golokango, dwelled there long ago until Golokango's evil ways forced the virtuous Ranage to encase his brother in stone. Ranage then transformed himself into a tree to surround and protect the rock for all time. By telling this tale, you condemn an enemy to a stony fate similar to Golokango's and summon plants to surround them.
When you Cast this Spell, every square adjacent to the target becomes difficult terrain from the sudden eruption of plant life for 1 minute. The target also attempts a Fortitude save.

Success: The target is {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 1} as their feet are bound within stone. This condition lasts until they move from their current position.
Failure: The target is {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 2} and {@condition immobilized|PC1} as their legs are encased in rock. The {@condition clumsy|PC1} condition lasts until they move from their current position, and they can {@action Escape|PC1} from being {@condition immobilized|PC1} with a check against your spell DC.
Critical Failure: The target is {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 2} and {@condition restrained} as nearly their entire body is covered in basalt. The {@condition clumsy|PC1} condition lasts until they move from their current position, and they can {@action Escape|PC1} from being {@condition restrained} with a successful check against your spell DC.

name: Turbulent Tide
entries: You cause the sheath of water and the improvised weapon it surrounds to surge outward with stupendous force as you attack. Make a melee {@action Strike|PC1} with your improvised weapon. The weapon then breaks, and each creature adjacent to you must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC or be pushed 5 feet away from you (10 feet on a critical failure). You can {@action Stride|PC1} after the target of your {@action Strike|PC1} if they are pushed but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.

If the item has a Hardness greater than your level, or if it's an artifact, {@trait cursed} item, or other item that's difficult to break or destroy, it doesn't break and adjacent creatures don't need to attempt Fortitude saves.

name: Threefold Limb
entries: You temporarily transform one of your limbs into water, taking the form of ice, liquid water, or steam as you desire. Make a melee spell attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 2d6} damage; the type of damage dealt and any additional effect depends on the form you choose. On a critical hit, double the damage.

items.name: Ice
entries: The limb deals cold damage, and the target takes a −10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn. This spell gains the {@trait cold} trait.

items.name: Liquid Water
entries: The limb deals bludgeoning damage and you can {@action Reposition|PC1} the target up to 10 feet.

items.name: Steam
entries: The limb deals fire damage and steam clings to the target, making all creatures {@condition concealed|PC1} to them until the start of your next turn or they perform an {@action Interact|PC1} action to wave the steam away. This spell gains the {@trait fire} trait.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 2d6}.

name: Unbroken Panoply
targets: 1 {@condition broken|PC1} weapon that is unattended or held by a willing creature
entries: As tools of violence undone by violence, {@condition broken|PC1} weapons contain potent symbolic magic that faydhaans often call upon when forming alliances. Images of similar legendary weapons overlay the target, and the weapon's {@condition broken|PC1} condition is suppressed for the duration. The weapon gains the {@trait nonlethal} trait during this time. The weapon's wielder can apply the weapon's item bonus to attack rolls, if any, to their {@skill Diplomacy|PC1} checks.
If the weapon would be damaged or {@condition broken|PC1} again, this spell ends.

name: Annunciation of the Outer Gate
entries: You announce yourself in the name of certain grim pacts that predate mortal life. This is not a compulsion, but rather an invitation of sorts. The invitation is understood by creatures in the area with telepathy and any who understand {@language Aklo|PC1}, {@language Chthonian|PC1}, {@language Empyrean|PC1}, {@language Fey|PC1}, or Utopian. Those who accept the invitation cannot take {@condition hostile|PC1} action against others who agreed until 10 minutes pass and can communicate telepathically with them during that time. This effect ends immediately if any {@condition hostile|PC1} action is taken against a creature that agreed.
Those creatures who decline the choice or do not understand it must attempt a Will save.

Success: The creature is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1}. If it understood the invitation, its {@condition frightened|PC1} status doesn't decrease at the end of any turn in which it damaged a creature that agreed to the invitation.
Failure: As success, but the creature is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2}.
Critical Failure: As success, but the creature is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 3}.

name: Beseech the Sphinx
entries: You look to the great Sphinx constellation, wisest of all cosmic guides and favored of Phimater, asking them to lend their insight to the target. Choose one skill and one type of saving throw (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will). The target gains a +1 status bonus to those skill checks and saving throws for the duration.

4: The status bonus increases to +2.
7: The status bonus increases to +3.

name: Buzzing Servants
entries: You summon a swarm of bees from the city of Axis that rapidly constructs geometric shapes from wax. The bees appear in an unoccupied square, building a structure of hexagons, squares, and decagons that fill the space. The wax shape has a Hardness of 10 and 40 Hit Points but also decays over 24 hours.

When you {@action Sustain|PC1} the spell, you can choose another unoccupied square in range that the bees move to and fill with wax shapes. Any amount of area or {@trait splash} damage to the square they're present in kills the bees, ending further construction.

name: Coiling Dance
entries: You perform a dance that seeks to pass on the knowledge and wisdom of a naga. Your allies in the area are filled with sacred energy, making their spells and attacks holy. Creatures or effects that would be {@trait unholy} don't gain this benefit.

When you cast or {@action Sustain|PC1} this spell, you can choose an ally in the area that's {@condition grabbed|PC1}, {@condition immobilized|PC1}, or {@condition restrained|PC1}. They can immediately use a reaction to {@action Escape|PC1}; they can use your {@skill Occultism|PC1} or {@skill Religion|PC1} modifier for the check instead of their unarmed attack, {@skill Acrobatics|PC1}, or {@skill Athletics|PC1} modifier if that would be better.

name: Disruptive Transfer
entries: Using Venorium Blorm's formulas, you calculate a path through space. Teleport to an empty square you can see within range. Creatures adjacent to your initial location witness an array of overlapping destinations. Each of them must succeed at a Will save or become {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 minute.

name: Chrysopoetic Curse
entries: You grant the target the gift of riches, giving them the power to turn anything they touch to gold. The target must attempt a Will save.

Success: The target's skin turns their armor and clothing partially to gold. If the target is wearing any armor or clothing, they become {@condition encumbered|PC1}.
Failure: As success, but the curse extends to the target's held weapons and other gear. If the target is holding any weapons or other objects, they become {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 3}, and the objects' Hardness is reduced by 5.
Critical Failure: The curse becomes even stronger, extending to the surrounding terrain. As failure, and if the creature is standing on a solid surface, the ground in their space transmutes itself into a quagmire of liquid gold. The gold is greater difficult terrain. If the creature leaves its square (or when the curse ends), any affected terrain returns to its original shape and substance and the terrain in the new square transmutes to gold.

entries: Any objects that were turned to gold return to their previous form and original shape when they leave the target's possession or the spell ends. As long as the target did not critically succeed on their saving throw, {@dice 2d6} gp worth of gold flakes and dust are left behind as the curse recedes.

name: Devouring Void
entries: Countless tears in space appear in the area, like hungry mouths. When the spell is cast and the first time each round it's sustained, living creatures in its area take {@damage 7d8} void damage (basic Fortitude save). A living creature using a move action to leave the area must succeed at a Reflex save or their action is disrupted at the edge of the area.

1: The void damage increases by {@damage 1d8}.

name: Indolent Haze
entries: The faint scent of poppies and a soothing calm fill the area, urging creatures to lay down and take a rest, to do nothing at all, ever again. Creatures in the area when you Cast the Spell must attempt a Will save. Creatures who end their turn in the area must also attempt the save. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.

Success: The creature lies down to rest, becoming {@condition prone|PC1}. If they were already {@condition prone|PC1}, they instead drift off to sleep, becoming {@condition unconscious|PC1}.
Failure: As success, except that the creature is so happy lying down that they cannot attempt to {@action Stand|PC1} or otherwise maneuver themself off of the ground on their next turn, though they can {@action Crawl|PC1} (potentially to escape the spell's area).
Critical Failure: The creature immediately lies down and drifts off to sleep, becoming {@condition prone} and {@condition unconscious|PC1}.

entries: Any creature in the area who is already {@condition unconscious|PC1} when you Cast the Spell (or whose turn ends in the spell's area while they are {@condition unconscious|PC1}) takes {@damage 6d4} spirit damage as their life force is {@condition drained|PC1} away through their dreams. This damage does not automatically wake them.

1: The spirit damage increases by {@damage 2d4}.

name: Love's Sacrifice
trigger: You take damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.
entries: You cry out for aid, and a creature near you feels compelled to throw itself in front of the threat as the ultimate expression of their love. A target that genuinely loves the caster without magical compulsion, at their player's or the GM's discretion, fails the save.

Success: The creature moves adjacent to you, moving further than its Speed if necessary as the magic compels it to exceed its limits. It takes half the damage you would have taken, while you take the rest. If you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you're reduced to 1 instead.
Failure: As success, except they take the full damage. If the damage reduces them to 0 Hit Points, they immediately die; this is a {@trait death} effect.

name: Thief of Fortune
targets: one beneficial spell effect currently affecting a creature, with a duration of 10 minutes or less
entries: Seeing another creature improve themself with magic, you reach out and seize its benefits for yourself. Attempt a counteract check against the target spell effect. If you successfully counteract the effect, the effect does not end. Instead, you gain the effect of the target spell as well. If you would not be a valid target for the spell, you do not gain any of its benefits.

The spell's duration is halved as you siphon off its magical energy for yourself. Each round that both you and the original creature are affected by the spell counts for two rounds when determining the spell's duration. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.

name: All-Encompassing Hunger
entries: You reach out to devour a life, regardless of whether you need it for sustenance. The target takes {@damage 1d6} void damage, with a basic Fortitude save. If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it dies, and you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

name: Crescent Scepter

duration.entry: until the beginning of your next turn

entries: You hold up any object, which takes on the appearance of glowing regalia in the eyes of those who look on you, representing the political or religious institute most feared by each creature. If a creature attempts to attack you during the spell's duration, it must attempt a Will save.

Success: The creature becomes {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1}, the penalty applying to its attack roll.
Failure: As success, but {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2}.

name: Cutting Eye
trigger: You are the target of an attack or must attempt a saving throw against a spell.
requirements: You're aware of the attack or spell.
entries: Your eyes open enviously, stealing the power of an opponent for yourself. You are not {@condition off-guard|PC1} to the attacker or spellcaster until the beginning of your next turn. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against the triggering attack or a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering save.

name: Heart's Hook
entries: You drive two creatures toward a fated meeting. Each will be compelled toward the other, but you can elect to have one automatically succeed on its saving throw.

Success: The creature is unaffected.
Failure: The creature must spend the first action on its next turn to approach its partner. It can't {@action Delay|PC1} or take any reactions until it has obeyed this urge.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the target must use all its actions on its next turn.

name: Precious Gleam

duration.entry: until the beginning of your next turn

entries: You temporarily enhance a weapon, replacing it with finer materials. On the next successful attack with that weapon during the spell's duration, the attack deals an additional {@damage 1d6} precision damage. You can choose for the metal to become your choice of cold iron, silver, or steel, causing the attack to bypass resistances accordingly.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

name: Reclined Apport
targets: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less
entries: Walking over to an item to pick it up is so much effort. Whether it's your spellbook, a reagent, or a glass of wine, it's simply more efficient to call it to your hand. You teleport the target into your open hand. If you don't have a hand free, it falls to the ground at your feet.

3: You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.
5: The range increases to 120 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.
7: The range increases to 120 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

name: Vengeful Glare
entries: Your gaze falls on a creature, filled with icy vengeance or fiery wrath. The gaze deals {@dice 1d4} damage (basic Fortitude save). It deals your choice of cold damage or fire damage and gains the appropriate trait. If you already dealt damage to the creature earlier this turn, it also takes 1 {@condition persistent damage} of the gaze's type.

1: The initial damage increases by {@damage 1d4} and {@condition persistent damage} by 1.

name: Personal Runewell
entries: The runelords of Thassilon pioneered the creation of {@i runewells}, magical artifacts that could extract and store the power of sin magic from mortal souls. A circle of light carves its way across the ground as you create your very own {@i runewell}, your personal rune flaring to life within it as you add your own sin to those seven revered in the past. Whenever any creature Casts a Spell within your {@i personal runewell}, the well resonates, with your choice of effects.

items: The runewell amplifies the power of your spells, as well as those of your allies. If the spell deals damage and doesn't have a duration, the well adds a status bonus to damage equal to the spell's rank.
The runewell punishes enemies foolish enough to attempt magic in your seat of power, firing arcane bolts at the spell's caster that deal {@damage 4d6} force damage, with a basic Reflex save.

entries: If you cast {@i personal runewell} a second time, your previous {@i personal runewell} vanishes. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.

1: The amount of damage dealt by the runewell's bolts increases by {@dice 1d6}.

name: Avenging Wildwood
entries: A Medium tree sprouts in an unoccupied square within range, its branches capable of striking out at your foes. This animated tree uses your spell attack modifier for its attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC − 10, and it has 20 Hit Points. Other creatures can't occupy its space, but allies can pass through its space. When you Cast the Spell and each time you {@action Sustain|PC1} it, you can have the tree make a branches {@action Strike|PC1}  against a creature within 15 feet of it, dealing {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. You choose the damage type each time.

If the tree is in soil and survives to the end of the spell's duration, it remains as an ordinary, non-magical tree and continues to grow and thrive. The GM might determine that the tree disappears immediately in certain inhospitable situations.

2: The animated tree has 10 additional Hit Points, and its branches {@action Strike|PC1}  deals {@damage 1d8} additional damage.

name: Eagle's Cry
entries: You let out the mighty cry of a majestic eagle that pierces eardrums. This cry deals {@damage 4d8} sonic damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Success: The creature takes half damage and is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1}.
Failure: The creature takes full damage and is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2}.
Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage, is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2}, and is {@condition fleeing|PC1} for 1 round.

2: The damage increases by {@damage 3d8}.

name: Equal Footing
targets: 1 creature with a land Speed greater than yours
entries: You level the field between yourself and another creature, hampering its movements if it's quicker than you. The target attempts a Will save.

Success: The target is {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 1} and takes a −10-foot status penalty to all its Speeds until the end of your next turn.
Failure: The target is {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 1} and takes a −15-foot status penalty to all its Speeds for 1 minute. During this time, it can't benefit from bonuses to its Speeds or take other penalties to its Speeds.
Critical Failure: The target is {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 2} and takes a −15-foot status penalty to all its Speeds for 1 minute. During this time, it can't benefit from bonuses to its Speeds or take other penalties to its Speeds.

name: Radiant Globe
entries: You create a dome of brilliant light that destroys projectiles attempting to pass through it. Ammunition from physical ranged attacks—such as arrows, bolts, sling bullets, and other objects of similar size—is destroyed in a flash of light when it passes into or out of the globe's area. Attackers targeting creatures or objects through the globe's surface with physical ranged attacks must succeed at a Fortitude save or become {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 round ({@condition blinded|PC1} for 1 round on a critical failure).

name: Unexpected Windfall
entries: Coins, trinkets carved from heavy stone, and other cumbersome treasures rain down upon a foe. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Success: The target is {@condition encumbered} for 1 round.
Failure: The target is {@condition encumbered} for the duration of the spell.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the extra weight also knocks the target {@condition prone}.

name: Capital Dividend
trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.
entries: Through diet and other strict regimens, you've fortified your body as Kalistrade's teachings have fortified your mind. You remain at 1 Hit Point, and your skin takes on a slight warm glow.
For the next minute, any time you would regain Hit Points from a {@trait healing} effect, this magic amplifies the effect, and you regain an additional 8 Hit Points.

1: The additional healing increases by 2 Hit Points.

name: Attacked from Within
entries: You assert your power over the target's own spirit as you reach deep into its soul in order to discover a moment of excruciating anguish, debilitating humiliation, or abject despair. The target takes {@damage 12d8} spirit damage and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success: The target takes no damage, with a brief sensation of pain followed by a pleasant memory.
Success: The target takes half damage and is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1}.
Failure: The target takes full damage and is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2}.
Critical Failure: The target takes double damage and is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2} and {@condition off-guard|PC1} for 1 round.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 2d8}.

name: Defended by Spirits
entries: You entreat a spirit or the spiritual energies in your location to surround and protect an ally from an certain foe. Each time the enemy attacks and damages the ally, the enemy takes {@damage 1d6} spirit damage. The enemy is aware of these spirits and has a general sense that attacking the ally will draw the spirits' ire.

2: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

name: Manifestation of Spirits
entries: You open the target's eyes to the plethora of spirits surrounding it—and it sees all these spirits as menacing and powerful. The target must attempt a Will save.

Success: The target believes every spirit it sees is an imminent threat. It's {@condition stupefied|PC1|stupefied 3} for 1 round.
Failure: As success, but the effect lasts 1 minute.
Critical Failure: As failure, and the target becomes {@condition confused|PC1} for 1 round

6: You can target up to 5 creatures

name: Pain of Ages
entries: You sense a spiritual resonance of deep anguish in the earth beneath your feet, the walls surrounding you, or the fragments of souls left behind in a place of calamity. You draw on this reservoir of pain and unleash its force against your enemies, dealing {@damage 8d8} spirit damage. On a critical failure, the creature is also {@condition stunned|PC1} for 1 round as it reels from the impact of so much anguish.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 2d8}.

name: Spirit Ward
entries: You draw on nearby spiritual energy or on echoes of the spirits you've invoked throughout your life to temporarily ward living flesh against dangerous spirits. You grant the target a +1 status bonus to saving throws against spells and effects caused by creatures that have the {@trait spirit} trait and haunts. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

items.name: {@as 1}
entries: The spell has a range of touch.

items.name: {@as 2}
entries: ({@trait concentrate}) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you target a living creature, the bonus increases to +2.

items.name: {@as 3}
entries: ({@trait concentrate}) You create a ward in a 30-foot emanation. This targets you and all your allies in the burst.

name: Spiritual Renewal
entries: You draw upon the restorative power of the spirits around you. The target gains fast healing 8.

1: The fast healing increases by 2.

name: Spiritual Transport
entries: You call upon the spiritual energies surrounding you to teleport you to an unoccupied space within range that you can see. Any items you're wearing and holding come with you. Your familiar or animal companion, if you have one that's sharing your space or adjacent to your space, is transported with you, but any other creature sharing your space remains in that space.

7: The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative direction from you.

name: Veil of Spirits
entries: You draw on the essence of spiritual energy surrounding you to manifest a misty veil. When a creature that isn't immune to spirit damage begins its turn within the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the veil.

Success: The creature is {@condition dazzled|PC1} until the beginning of its next turn.
Failure: The creature is {@condition dazzled|PC1} and gains a weakness to spirit damage equal to half your level until the beginning of its next turn as spiritual energy clings to it. A creature with spiritsense can't use that imprecise sense while it's {@condition dazzled|PC1} in this way.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the weakness is equal to your level.

name: Menacing Lament
entries: You wail a dirge for your enemies. Enemies in the area are {@condition off-guard|PC1} against your attacks and gain no benefits from flanking you for the duration.

name: Valiant Anthem
entries: You chant a rallying cry to bolster your allies. Your allies in the area gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds and a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

name: Elemental Sheath
entries: You coat yourself in nature's power. Choose {@trait air}, {@trait earth}, {@trait fire}, {@trait metal}, {@trait water}, or {@trait wood}; the spell gains that trait. You become completely covered by armor formed from that element, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 5 to two types of damage based on the element you choose.
{@b Air} bludgeoning and electricity; {@b Earth} bludgeoning and poison; {@b Fire} fire and slashing; {@b Metal} acid and slashing; {@b Water} cold and piercing; {@b Wood} piercing and void.

2: The resistance increases by 5.

name: Vicious Howl
entries: You howl with passion for your cause, empowering yourself to push beyond your limits. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. If you reduce a {@trait fiend} to 0 Hit Points during this duration, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to the creature's level.

name: Friendly Push
entries: You exert magical force to propel a willing creature up to 10 feet in a straight line, including upward, though if they aren't on solid ground or have another way to maintain their height (such as a fly Speed) when the movement ends, they fall. When you {@action Sustain|PC1} the spell, you can move them again or choose a new target within range and move them instead. You can cast this spell on an {@condition unconscious|PC1} ally, and if you do, the movement from this spell doesn't trigger reactions.

4: The distance increases to 20 feet.
7: The distance increases to 30 feet.

name: Rapid Retreat
trigger: You take damage from an attack or spell.
entries: You know how to swiftly escape from harm. You instantly teleport out of danger into an unoccupied space within range, and you gain resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to your level. You can't Cast this Spell if there's no space to move into.

name: Echo Jump
entries: You teleport to an unoccupied space within range, leaving behind a faint echo of your form that explodes with magical force. Each creature within a 10-foot emanation from your previous location takes {@damage 4d8} force damage.

2: The range increases by 10 feet, and the damage increases by {@damage 3d8}.

name: Forest of Gates
targets: you and up to 6 willing creatures touched
entries: You transport yourself and your allies to a peaceful extraplanar realm of towering trees, each of which holds a misty gateway to another location. When you Cast this Spell, you choose a specific destination within 1,000 miles that you can identify by its position relative to your starting position and by its appearance (or other identifying features). Incorrect knowledge of the location causes the spell to fail. You and your allies walk for 1 hour through the forest, and each of you regains Hit Points and reduces the value of any {@condition doomed|PC1} or {@condition drained|PC1} condition as if you'd taken a full night's rest. At the end of the journey, you attempt a DC 40 {@skill Arcana|PC1} or {@skill Nature|PC1} check to find the correct gate to your desired location.

Critical Success: You and your allies arrive within 1,000 feet of your desired location.
Success: You and your allies arrive within 1 mile of your desired location.
Failure: You and your allies arrive within 10 miles of your desired location.
Critical Failure: You and your allies exit the forest within 1 mile of your original location.

name: King's Castle
entries: You and a willing creature swap places. You appear in the target's former space, and the target appears in your former space. You and your target must each be able to fit in the new spaces within range; otherwise, the spell fails.

name: Sudden Transposition
entries: You wrench the targets off their feet, forcefully teleporting them within the area. The creatures must each be able to fit in their new space, and their positions must be unoccupied, entirely within the area, and in your line of sight. Each target attempts a Fortitude save.

Critical Success: The target can teleport if it wants, but it chooses the destination within the area.
Success: The target is unaffected.
Failure: You teleport the target and choose its destination; the target takes {@damage 10d10} bludgeoning damage.
Critical Failure: You teleport the target and choose its destination; the target takes {@damage 20d10} bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone|PC1}.

name: Trade Items
targets: 1 item you're holding and 1 item in another creature's possession you can see, each no more than light Bulk
entries: You magically swap an item you're holding for another that someone else has. The second item appears in the hand you were holding the first item (or it falls to the ground in your square if you're unable to hold it), and the first item appears in the same place on the other creature's possession where the second item was (held in a hand or attached to a belt, for instance). If the second item is in the possession of a creature unwilling to relinquish it, they can prevent the transposition with a successful Reflex save.

5: Each object's maximum Bulk increases to 1. If one of the items is 1 Bulk and the other isn't, an unwilling creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their saving throw.

name: Warping Pull
trigger: An effect would deal damage to an ally within range.
targets: 1 willing creature that would take damage from the triggering effect
entries: You get an ally out of danger with a teleporting pull. You teleport the target to an unoccupied square up to 10 feet closer to you. The target gains resistance 5 to all damage against the triggering effect.

2: The resistance increases by 5.

name: Magic Warrior Aspect
entries: You call upon the aspect of the animal from your mask, gaining physical features reminiscent of that animal. You morph slightly into that creature, gaining the Speeds and senses you would gain from using {@spell animal form} to turn into the type of animal your mask represents; these special Speeds can't be increased by status bonuses or item bonuses.

name: Magic Warrior Transformation
entries: You transform into the animal from your mask. You gain the effects of {@spell animal form}, heightened to magic warrior transformation's level, and you can transform into only the type of animal your mask represents.

name: Mantis Form
entries: You become a mantis. You gain the effects of insect form, heightened to mantis form's level, and you can only transform into a mantis.

name: Perfect Strike
trigger: You miss a {@action Strike} with an unarmed attack.
entries: You call upon insight from your training to recover accuracy.
Reroll the missed attack roll and keep the new result.

name: Snowball
entries: You throw a magically propelled and chilled ball of dense snow. The target takes {@damage 2d4} cold damage and potentially other effects, depending on the result of your spell attack roll.

entries.Critical Success: The target takes double damage and a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.
entries.Success: The target takes full damage and a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.
entries.Failure: No effect.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 2d4}.

name: Unblinking Flame Revelation
requirements: Your previous action was a successful unarmed {@action Strike}.
entries: You light your foe with revealing flame. The GM attempts a secret counteract check against each illusion affecting the creature; on a success, you suppress the illusion for the duration, rather than end the effect.

name: Unbreaking Wave Advance
entries: You unleash a mighty wave from your hand that buffets back your foes. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. If a creature pushed by unbreaking wave advance would be pushed into a solid barrier or another creature, it stops at that point and takes {@dice 3d6} damage.

entries.Success: The creature is unaffected.
entries.Failure: The creature is pushed 10 feet.
entries.Critical Failure: The creature is pushed 20 feet.

1: The damage for pushing a creature into a solid barrier increases by {@dice 1d6}.

name: Unfolding Wind Rush
entries: You travel on a rushing wind. Move two times: two {@action Stride||Strides}, two {@action Step||Steps}, or one {@action Stride} and one {@action Step} (in either order). You can {@action Stride} or {@action Step} into the air during this movement, moving upward at a 45-degree angle at most; if you end your movement in the air, you fall after taking one action or when your turn ends, whichever comes first. A {@spell wall of wind} appears in all the spaces you left during this movement, lasting for 1 round.

5: The wall of wind lasts 3 rounds.

name: Untwisting Iron Buffer
entries: You send currents of protective ki to the surface of your body that protect you from harm, at least until your enemies dissipate them.
You gain 15 temporary Hit Points, which last for up to 3 rounds.

1: The temporary Hit Points increase by 5.

name: Internal Insurrection
entries: You afflict the target with the supernatural disease known as internal insurrection, causing portions of their body to rebel against the whole, leading to painful agonies and, in time, death. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Success: The target becomes {@condition clumsy||clumsy 1} for 1 round as pain wracks their body.
Failure: The target is afflicted with internal insurrection at stage 1.
Critical Failure: The target is afflicted with internal insurrection at stage 2.

entries.name: Internal Insurrection
notes: The target can't recover from the {@condition clumsy} condition from internal insurrection until the disease is cured

stages.entry: death, and the target's body splits apart into a mass of fragments that crawls outward in a 10-foot-emanation before perishing, leaving a bare skeleton surrounded by gore.

name: Allegro
entries: You perform rapidly, speeding up your ally. The ally becomes {@condition quickened|PC1} and can use the additional action to {@action Strike|PC1}, {@action Stride|PC1}, or {@action Step|PC1}.

name: Counter Performance
trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet rolls a saving throw against an {@trait auditory} or {@trait visual} effect.
entries: Your performance protects you and your allies. Roll a {@skill Performance|PC1} check for a type you know—it must be an auditory performance if the trigger was auditory or a visual one for a visual trigger, and this action gains the traits for the type of performance. You and allies in the area can use the better result between your {@skill Performance|PC1} check and the saving throw.

name: Courageous Anthem
entries: You inspire yourself and your allies with words or tunes of encouragement. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against {@trait fear} effects.

name: Dirge of Doom
entries: Enemies within the area are {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1}. They can't reduce their {@condition frightened|PC1} value below 1 while they remain in the area.

name: Fatal Aria
entries: You perform music so perfect that the target may die of joy or sorrow. Once targeted, the creature becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute. The effect of the spell depends on the target's level and current Hit Points.

entry: If the target has 50 Hit Points or fewer, it dies instantly; otherwise, it drops to 0 Hit Points and becomes {@condition dying|PC1|dying 1}.
The target takes 50 damage. If this brings it to 0 Hit Points, it dies instantly.

name: Fortissimo Composition
entries: You call upon your muse to greatly increase the benefits you provide with your {@spell courageous anthem|PC1}, {@spell rallying anthem|PC1}, or {@spell song of strength|PC1} composition. If your next action is to cast one of these compositions, attempt a {@skill Performance|PC1} check. The DC is usually the highest Will DC of the composition's targets, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances.
The effect of your composition depends on the result of your check.

Critical Success: The status bonus from your composition increases to +3.
Success: The status bonus from your composition increases to +2.
Failure: Your composition provides only its normal bonus of +1, but you don't spend the Focus Point for casting this spell.

name: House of Imaginary Walls
entries: You mime an {@condition invisible|PC1|invisible} 10-foot-by-10-foot wall adjacent to you and within your reach. The wall is solid to those creatures that don't disbelieve it, even {@trait incorporeal} creatures. You and your allies can voluntarily believe the wall exists to continue to treat it as solid, for instance to climb onto it. A creature that disbelieves the illusion is temporarily immune to your house of imaginary walls for 1 minute. The wall doesn't block creatures that didn't see your visual performance, nor does it block objects. The wall has AC 10, Hardness equal to double the spell's rank, and HP equal to quadruple the spell's rank.

name: Hymn of Healing
entries: Your glorious singing mends wounds and provides a temporary respite from harm. The target gains fast healing 2. When you Cast the Spell and the first time each round you {@action Sustain|PC1|Sustain the Spell}, the target gains 2 temporary Hit Points, which last for 1 round.

1: The fast healing and temporary Hit Points each increase by 2.

name: Lingering Composition
entries: You add a flourish to your composition to extend its benefits. If your next action is to cast a cantrip composition with a duration of 1 round, attempt a {@skill Performance|PC1} check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of a level equal to the highestlevel target of your composition, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The effect depends on the result of your check.

Success: The composition lasts 3 rounds.
Failure: The composition lasts 1 round, but you don't spend the Focus Point for casting this spell.

name: Loremaster's Etude
trigger: You or an ally within range attempts a skill check to {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1}
entries: You call upon your muse's deep mysteries, granting the target a greater ability to think and recall information. Roll the triggering {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1} skill check twice and use the higher result.

name: Ode to Ouroboros
trigger: A creature's {@condition dying|PC1} condition would reach the value at which they would die.
entries: Your ode staves off death. The target's {@condition dying|PC1} condition remains 1 below the value at which it dies. This doesn't help prevent death from effects that kill the target without increasing its {@condition dying|PC1} condition, such as disintegrate and {@trait death} effects.

name: Pied Piping
entries: Your performance enraptures listeners, compelling them to follow you. Each creature within the emanation must attempt a Will save when you {@action Cast a Spell|PC1|Cast the Spell|PC1} or the first time they enter the area, after which they become temporarily immune for 1 day. Once per turn, you can {@action Sustain|PC1} the composition to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.

Success: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} with you.
Failure: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} by you and uses all its actions to move toward you and compliment your performance.
This effect ends if a {@condition hostile|PC1} action is used against the affected creature.
Critical Failure: The target gains the {@trait minion} trait and is {@condition controlled|PC1} by you. This effect ends if a {@condition hostile|PC1} action is used against the affected creature, or if you direct the creature to use any action that causes it harm.

name: Rallying Anthem
entries: Your song moves allies to protect themselves more effectively. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws, as well as resistance equal to half the spell's rank to physical damage.

name: Song of Marching
entries: You maintain a brisk performance that keeps allies on the move. You and your allies in the area can {@action Hustle|PC1} for the spell's duration, in addition to your other exploration activities (your exploration activity is {@action Sustain|PC1|Sustaining this Spell}). You and your allies then become temporarily immune for 1 day.

If you enter an encounter while performing this song, you can use your {@skill Performance|PC1} modifier for the initiative roll. You and your affected allies also receive a +1 status bonus to that initiative roll.

6: You can {@action Sustain|PC1|Sustain the Spell} for up to 2 hours.
9: You can {@action Sustain|PC1|Sustain the Spell} for up to 4 hours

name: Song of Strength
entries: You bolster your allies' physical strength with a hearty exhortation. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to {@skill Athletics|PC1} checks and to their DCs against {@skill Athletics|PC1} skill actions such as {@action Disarm|PC1}, {@action Reposition|PC1}, {@action Shove|PC1}, and {@action Trip|PC1}.

name: Soothing Ballad
entries: You draw upon your muse to soothe your allies. Choose one of the following three effects:

items: The spell attempts to counteract {@trait fear} effects on the targets.
The spell attempts to counteract effects imposing paralysis on the targets.
The spell restores {@dice 7d8} Hit Points to the targets.

1: When used to heal, soothing ballad restores {@dice 1d8} more Hit Points.

name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart
entries: Your symphony lifts listeners from their worldly concerns. Attempt a {@skill Performance|PC1} check to counteract an effect applying one of the following conditions to the target: {@condition grabbed|PC1}, {@condition immobilized|PC1}, {@condition paralyzed|PC1}, {@condition restrained|PC1}, {@condition slowed|PC1}, or {@condition stunned|PC1}. If you fail, you can't target the same effect on the target for 1 day.
Use the condition's source to determine the counteract DC (for example, the {@action Escape|PC1} DC for {@condition grabbed|PC1}).

9: You can target up to four creatures.

name: Triple Time
entries: Your music sets a fast pace. You and all allies in the area gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds for 1 round.

name: Uplifting Overture
entries: Your performance makes allies feel they can succeed at anything. This counts as having prepared to {@action Aid|PC1} your ally on a skill check of your choice. When you later use the {@action Aid|PC1} reaction, you can roll {@skill Performance|PC1} instead of the normal skill check, and if you roll a failure, you get a success instead. If you are legendary in {@skill Performance|PC1}, you automatically critically succeed.
The GM might rule that you can't use this ability if the act of encouraging your ally would interfere with the skill check (such as a check to {@action Sneak|PC1} quietly or maintain a disguise).

name: Pushing Gust
entries: Giving the air a push, you buffet the target with a powerful gust of wind; it must attempt a Fortitude save.

Success: The target is pushed 5 feet away from you.
Failure: The target is pushed 10 feet away from you.
Critical Failure: The target is pushed 10 feet away from you and knocked {@condition prone|PC1}.

name: Disperse into Air
trigger: You take damage from an enemy or a hazard.
entries: After taking the triggering damage, you transform into air. Until the end of the current turn, you can't be attacked or targeted, you don't take up space, you can't act, and any auras or emanations you have are suppressed. At the end of the turn, you re-form in any space you can occupy within 15 feet of where you were when you dispersed. Any auras or emanations you had are restored as long as their duration didn't run out while you were dispersed.

name: Ignite Ambition
trigger: You or an ally in range attempt to use a {@trait mental} effect to convince a creature to do something (such as a {@action Coerce|PC1}, {@action Request|PC1}, or a {@spell suggestion|PC1} spell).
entries: You strengthen the target's ambition, increase its resentment of its allies, and make its allegiances more susceptible to change. It must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success: The target is unaffected and realized you attempted to influence its reaction with magic.
Success: The target takes a –1 status penalty to its defenses against the triggering effect. This penalty is –2 if the target is being encouraged to advance its own ambitions. The target doesn't realize you Cast the Spell on it.
Failure: As success, but the status penalty is –4 if the target is being encouraged to advance its own ambitions.
Critical Failure: As success, but the creature automatically follows a suggestion that advances its own ambitions.

name: Competitive Edge
entries: Your competitiveness drives you to prove yourself against the opposition. You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks. If an enemy within 20 feet critically succeeds at an attack roll or skill check, your status bonus increases to +3 for attack rolls or that specific skill check (whichever the foe critically succeeded at) for 1 round.

7: Increase the base bonus to +2 and the increased bonus after an enemy critically succeeds to +4.

name: Face in the Crowd
entries: While in a crowd of roughly similar creatures, your appearance becomes bland and nondescript. You gain a +2 status bonus to {@skill Deception|PC1} and {@skill Stealth|PC1} checks to go incognito among the crowd, and you ignore difficult terrain caused by the crowd.
This counts as setting up a disguise for the {@action Impersonate|PC1} use of {@skill Deception|PC1} and you add your level even if you're untrained.

3: The spell gains a range of 10 feet and can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Pulse of Civilization
entries: You tap into the zeitgeist of any settlements in range. You learn the names of the settlements. On all {@skill Lore|PC1} checks to {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1} about those settlements or to {@action Gather Information|PC1} in or about those settlements, you gain a +2 status bonus and use your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained. When you Cast the Spell, you can immediately {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1} about one of the settlements using its {@skill Lore|PC1} skill (such as {@skill Lore|PC1|Absalom Lore}), which benefits from the bonus. If you cast pulse of civilization again, any previous casting ends.

5: The range is 100 miles.
7: The range is 500 miles and the bonus is +3.

name: Veil of Confidence
entries: You surround yourself in confidence. You reduce your current {@condition frightened|PC1} condition by 1, and whenever you would become {@condition frightened|PC1} during the duration, reduce the amount by 1. If you critically fail a save against a {@trait fear} effect, veil of confidence reduces your {@condition frightened|PC1} value from that effect, and then ends.

name: Delusional Pride
entries: You make the target overconfident, leading it to ascribe failure to external factors. The target attempts a Will save to determine the spell's duration and is temporarily immune for 24 hours regardless of the save's result.

Success: The duration is 1 round. If the target fails at an attack roll or skill check, it takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and skill checks until the end of its turn (or the end of its next turn, if it attempted the roll outside its turn). If the creature fails a second time while taking this penalty, the penalty increases to –2.
Failure: As success, but the duration is 10 minutes.
Critical Failure: As success, but the duration is 24 hours.

name: Creative Splash
entries: A deluge of paint or colorful illusions descend on the area, reflecting your personal creative specialty. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the color of the illusion. Each creature in the area must succeed at a Will save or take the effect listed on the table for the color.

name: Artistic Flourish
targets: 1 item or work of art that fits entirely within the range
entries: You transform the target into a form that more closes matches your creative vision. It's clearly the same item, but with aesthetic details you choose. The target is a beautiful and impressive piece for its new quality, but the effect is obviously magical and temporary, so its monetary value doesn't change. If you're an expert in {@skill Crafting|PC1}, the item grants a +1 item bonus to attack rolls if it's a weapon or skill checks if it's a skill tool.
When you Cast this Spell, any previous casting ends.

7: If you're a master in {@skill Crafting|PC1}, the item grants a +2 item bonus.
10: If you're legendary in {@skill Crafting|PC1}, the item grants a +3 item bonus.

name: Cloak of Shadow
entries: You drape the target in a mantle of swirling shadows that make it harder to see. The cloak reduces bright light within a 20-foot emanation to dim light. This is a form of magical darkness and can therefore overcome non-magical light or attempt to counteract magical light as described on page 431.

The target can use {@condition concealed|PC1} condition gained from the shadows to {@action Hide|PC1}, though observant creatures can still follow the moving aura of shadow, making it difficult for the target to become completely {@condition undetected|PC1}. The target can use an {@action Interact|PC1} action to remove the cloak and leave it behind as a decoy, where it remains, reducing light for the rest of the spell's duration. If anyone picks up the cloak after it's been removed by the original target, the cloak evaporates and the spell ends.

name: Darkened Sight
entries: You infuse a creature's vision with darkness. It receives greater darkvision, allowing it to see even in magical darkness.

name: Death's Call
trigger: A living creature within 20 feet of you dies, or an {@trait undead} creature within 20 feet of you is destroyed.
entries: Seeing another pass from this world invigorates you. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the triggering creature's level plus your spellcasting attribute modifier. If the triggering creature was undead, double the number of temporary Hit Points you gain. These last for the duration of the spell, and the spell ends if all the temporary Hit Points are depleted earlier.

name: Eradicate Undeath
entries: A massive deluge of life energy causes the undead to fall apart. Each {@trait undead} creature in the area takes {@damage 4d12} vitality damage.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 1d12}.

name: Cry of Destruction
entries: Your voice booms, smashing what's in front of you. Each creature and unattended object in the area takes {@damage 1d8} sonic damage. If you already dealt damage to an enemy this turn with a {@action Strike|PC1} or spell, increase the damage dice from this spell to {@dice d12|d12s}.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 1d8}.

name: Destructive Aura
entries: Swirling sands of divine devastation surround you, weakening the defenses of all they touch. Reduce the resistances of yourself and creatures in the area by 2.

2: Reduce the resistances by an additional 2.

name: Sweet Dream
entries: With soothing words, you lull the target into an enchanting dream. When you Cast the Spell, the target falls {@condition unconscious|PC1} if it wasn't already. While {@condition unconscious|PC1}, it experiences a dream of your choice, though lucidly enough it can wake when it pleases.
If it wakes up before 1 minute of sleep has passed, the spell ends.

items: {@b Dream of Insight} +1 status bonus to Intelligence-based skill checks
{@b Dream of Glamor} +1 status bonus to Charisma-based skill checks
{@b Dream of Voyaging} +5-foot status bonus to Speed

entries: If you Cast this Spell again, any previous sweet dream you cast ends.

4: The bonus for a dream of insight or glamor is +2.
7: The bonus for a dream of insight or glamor is +3.

name: Dreamer's Call
entries: You create a vivid, illusory daydream drawn from the images of the target's dreams. The daydream appears in an unoccupied space in range, and you attempt to draw the target toward it.

Success: The target's attention wavers. It becomes {@condition fascinated|PC1} by the daydream.
Failure: The target is {@condition fascinated|PC1} with the daydream and pursues a course of action you choose as its first action after you Cast the Spell: approach the daydream, run away from it (as the {@condition fleeing|PC1} condition), {@action Release|PC1} what it's holding as an offering, or {@action Drop Prone|PC1} in obeisance.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the target follows the course of action for as many actions as possible for the spell's duration, and does nothing else.

name: Hurtling Stone
entries: You evoke a magical stone and throw it, with divine guide to your aim. The stone deals {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage depending on your spell attack roll against the target's AC.

Critical Success: The target takes double damage and you can push it up to 10 feet.
Success: The target takes full damage and you can push it up to 5 feet.

1: The stone's damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

name: Localized Quake
entries: You shake the earth, toppling nearby creatures. Choose whether the spell's area is a 15-foot emanation or a 15-foot cone when you cast it. Each creature in the area standing on solid ground takes {@damage 4d6} bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex saving throw. A creature that fails its save also falls {@condition prone|PC1}.

1: Increase the damage by {@dice 2d6}.

name: Soothing Words
entries: You attempt to calm the target by uttering soothing words in a calm and even tone. The target gains a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 against {@trait emotion} effects.
In addition, when you Cast this Spell, you can attempt to counteract one {@trait emotion} effect on the target.

5: The bonus to saves increases to +2, or +3 against {@trait emotion} effects.

name: Unity
trigger: You and 1 or more allies within range are targeted by a spell or ability that allows a saving throw.
targets: each ally targeted by the triggering spell
entries: You put up a united defense. Each ally can use your saving throw modifier instead of its own against the triggering spell. Each ally decides individually which modifier to use.

name: Read Fate
entries: You attempt to learn more about the target's fate in the short term, usually within the next day for most prosaic creatures, or the next hour or less for someone likely to have multiple rapid experiences, such as someone actively adventuring.

You learn a single enigmatic word connected to the creature's fate in that time frame. Fate is notoriously inscrutable, and the word isn't necessarily meant to be taken at face value, so the meaning is often clear only in hindsight. The GM rolls a secret DC {@flatDC 6} flat check. If the creature's fate is too uncertain, or on a failed flat check, the spell yields the word "inconclusive. " Either way, the creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

name: Tempt Fate
trigger: You or an ally within range attempts a saving throw.
entries: You twist the forces of fate to make a moment dire or uneventful, with no in-between. The target gains a +1 status bonus to the triggering saving throw. If the saving throw's result is a success, it becomes a critical success. If it's a failure, it becomes a critical failure, and the critical failure can't be reduced by abilities that usually reduce critical failure.
If the triggering ability did not have both a critical success and critical failure condition, tempt fate fails, but you don't expend the Focus Point for Casting this Spell.

8: The bonus on the saving throw is +2.

name: Fire Ray
entries: A blazing band of fire arcs through the air, lighting your opponent and the ground they stand upon on fire. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC. The ray deals {@damage 2d6} fire damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit). On any result other than a critical failure, the ground in the target's space catches fire, dealing {@damage 1d6} fire damage to each creature that ends its turn in one of the squares.

1: The ray's initial damage increases by {@damage 2d6}, and the fire damage dealt by the burning space increases by {@dice 1d6}.

name: Flame Barrier
trigger: An effect would deal fire damage to you or an ally within range.
targets: one creature that would take fire damage from the triggering effect
entries: You swiftly deflect incoming flames. The target gains fire resistance 15 against the triggering effect.

2: The resistance increases by 5.

name: Unimpeded Stride
entries: Divine grace ensure that nothing can keep you prisoner or hold you back. You immediately escape from every {@trait magical} effect that has you {@condition immobilized|PC1} or {@condition grabbed|PC1} unless the effect is of a higher rank than your {@spell unimpeded stride|PC1} spell. You then {@action Stride|PC1}. During this movement, you ignore difficult terrain and any circumstance or status penalties to your Speed.

name: Word of Freedom
entries: You utter a liberating word of power that frees a creature. You suppress one of the following conditions of your choice: {@condition confused|PC1}, {@condition frightened|PC1}, {@condition grabbed|PC1}, {@condition paralyzed|PC1}, or {@condition restrained|PC1}. The target isn't affected by the chosen condition, and if you suppress the {@condition grabbed|PC1} or {@condition restrained|PC1} condition, the target automatically breaks free from the grab or restraint when you Cast the Spell.

If you don't remove the effect that provided the condition, the condition returns after the spell ends. For example, if a spell was making the target {@condition confused|PC1} for 1 minute, word of freedom would let the target act normally for a round, but the {@condition confused|PC1} condition would return afterward.

name: Healer's Blessing
entries: Your words bless a creature with an enhanced connection to vital energy. When the target regains Hit Points from a healing {@trait vitality} spell, it regains 2 additional Hit Points. The target regains additional Hit Points from {@spell healer's blessing|PC1} only the first time it regains HP from a given {@trait healing} spell, so a spell that heals the creature repeatedly over a duration would restore additional Hit Points only once, when they are first healed.

1: The additional healing increases by 2 HP.

name: Rebuke Death
targets: 1 living creature per action spent to Cast this Spell
entries: You snatch creatures from the jaws of death, restoring them without the strain of a typical close call. You can spend 1 to 3 actions Casting this Spell, and you can target a number of creatures equal to the actions spent. Each target regains {@dice 3d6} Hit Points. If the target had the {@condition dying|PC1} condition, coming back from {@condition dying|PC1} due to this healing doesn't increase its {@condition wounded|PC1} condition.

1: Increase the healing by {@dice 1d6}.

name: Overstuff
entries: Huge amounts of food and drink fill the target. It receives a full meal's worth of nourishment and must attempt a Fortitude save. A target {@condition sickened|PC1} by this spell takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed until it's no longer {@condition sickened|PC1}.

Success: The target is {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 1}, but if it spends an action to end the condition, it succeeds automatically.
Failure: The target is {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 1}.
Critical Failure: The target is {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 2}.

name: Take Its Course
entries: When someone has overindulged, you can hasten them past the worst of their affliction or intensify their misery. This spell attempts to progress a disease affliction, a poison affliction, or {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage} affecting the target. If the target is affected by more than one of these, choose from among those you are aware of; otherwise, the GM chooses randomly. An unwilling target can attempt a Will save to negate take its course.

The effect of this spell depends on whether you're attempting to end an affliction or {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage}, and whether you are attempting to help or hinder the target's recovery.

items: {@b Affliction} The target immediately attempts its next saving throw against the affliction. You can grant the creature your choice of a +2 status bonus or a –2 status penalty to its saving throw against the affliction.

{@b Persistent Poison} You can cause the target to take the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage} immediately when you Cast this Spell (in addition to taking it at the end of its next turn). Whether or not you do so, the target attempts an additional flat check against the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage}. You can set the DC of that flat check to 5 or 20 instead of the normal DC.

7: You can attempt to progress any number of the target's eligible afflictions and {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage}.

name: Scholarly Recollection
trigger: You attempt a {@skill Perception|PC1} check to {@action Seek|PC1}, or you attempt a skill check to {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1} with a skill you're trained in.
entries: Speaking a short prayer as you gather your thoughts, you're blessed to find yourself pointed in the right direction. The GM rolls the triggering check twice and uses the better result.

name: Know the Enemy
trigger: You roll initiative and can see a creature, you succeed at an attack roll against a creature, or a creature fails a saving throw against one of your spells.
entries: You quickly remind yourself of useful information. Use a {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1} action, rolling the appropriate skill check to identify the triggering creature's abilities. You can roll your check twice and use the better result.

name: Bit of Luck
entries: You tilt the scales of luck slightly to protect a creature from disaster. When the target would attempt a saving throw, it can roll twice and use the better result. Once it does this, the spell ends.

If you cast {@spell bit of luck|PC1} again, any previous bit of luck you cast that's still in effect ends. After a creature has been targeted with bit of luck, it becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

name: Lucky Break
trigger: You fail, but don't critically fail, a saving throw.
entries: Reroll the saving throw and use the better result. You then become temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

name: Magic's Vessel
entries: A creature becomes a divine receptacle for pure magical energy. The target gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. Each time you Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you automatically {@action Sustain|PC1|Sustain this Spell} and grant its target resistance to damage from spells equal to the spell's rank, until the start of your next turn.

name: Mystic Beacon
entries: The next damaging or healing spell the target casts before the start of your next turn deals damage or restores Hit Points as if the spell were heightened 1 rank higher than its actual rank. This applies only to initial healing or damage when the spell is cast, not any ongoing effects. The spell otherwise functions at its actual rank. Once the target casts the spell, mystic beacon ends.

name: Athletic Rush
entries: Your body fills with physical power and skill. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed and a +2 status bonus to {@skill Athletics|PC1} checks. As a part of Casting this Spell, you can use a {@action Stride|PC1}, {@action Leap|PC1}, {@action Climb|PC1}, or {@action Swim|PC1} action. The spell's bonuses apply during that action.

name: Enduring Might
trigger: An attack or effect would deal damage to you.
entries: Your own might mingles with divine power to protect you from harm. You gain resistance equal to 8 plus your Strength modifier against all damage from the triggering attack or effect.

1: The resistance increases by 2.

name: Moonbeam
entries: You shine a ray of moonlight. Make a spell attack roll. The beam of light deals {@damage 2d6} fire damage. This is silver damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like.

Critical Success: The beam deals double damage, and the target is {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 minute.
Success: The beam deals full damage, and the target is {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 round.

1: The ray's damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

name: Touch of the Moon
entries: When you touch the target, a symbol of the moon appears on its forehead, glowing with soft moonlight. The target glows with dim light in a 20-foot radius. It also gets a benefit based on a phase of the moon, starting with the new moon and changing to the next phase at the end of each of its turns.

items: {@b New Moon} The target receives no benefit.
{@b Waxing Moon} The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +4 status bonus to damage rolls.
{@b Full Moon} The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, AC, and saves, and a +4 status bonus to damage.
{@b Waning Moon} The target gains a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws. After this phase, return to the new moon.

name: Vibrant Thorns
entries: Your body sprouts brambly thorns that thrive on life magic. Adjacent creatures that hit you with a melee attack, as well as creatures that hit you with unarmed attacks, take 1 piercing damage each time they do. Anytime you cast a {@trait vitality} spell, the thorns' damage increases to {@dice 1d6} until the start of your next turn.

1: The damage increases by 1, or {@dice 1d6} after you cast a {@trait vitality} spell.

name: Nature's Bounty
entries: A palm-sized raw fruit or vegetable of your choice appears in your open hand. A creature can consume the food with an {@action Interact|PC1} action to regain {@dice 3d10+12} Hit Points and be nourished as if it had eaten a meal. If uneaten, the food crumbles to dust after 1 minute.

1: The Hit Points restored increase by 6.

name: Waking Nightmare
entries: You fill the creature's mind with a terrifying vision. The target must attempt a Will save. A creature {@condition frightened|PC1} by this spell takes 1 additional mental damage each time it's hit by a {@action Strike|PC1}.

Success: The target is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1}.
Failure: The target is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2}. If it's asleep, it wakes up and is {@condition paralyzed|PC1} for 1 round.
Critical Failure: As failure, but {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 3}.

1: The mental damage increases by 1.

name: Shared Nightmare
entries: Merging minds with the target, you swap distressing visions. One of you will become {@condition confused|PC1}, based on the target's Will save.

Success: At the start of your next turn, you spend your first action with the {@condition confused|PC1} condition, then act normally.
Failure: The target spends the first action of each of its turns {@condition confused|PC1}. The duration is 1 minute.
Critical Failure: The target is {@condition confused|PC1}. The duration is 1 minute.

name: Savor the Sting
entries: You inflict pain upon the target and revel in their anguish. This deals {@damage 1d4} mental damage and {@damage 1d4} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent mental damage}; the target must attempt a Will save. As long as the target is taking {@condition persistent damage|PC1} from this spell, you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks against the target.

Critical Success: SuccessThe target takes half damage and no {@condition persistent damage|PC1}.
Failure: The target takes full initial and {@condition persistent damage|PC1}.
Critical Failure: The target takes double initial and {@condition persistent damage|PC1}.

1: The initial damage increases by {@damage 1d4} and the {@condition persistent damage|PC1} increases by {@damage 1d4}.

name: Retributive Pain
trigger: A creature in range damages you.
entries: You vengefully reflect your pain upon your tormentor. The target takes mental damage equal to half the triggering damage.

name: Charming Touch
targets: 1 creature that could find you attractive
entries: You infuse your target with attraction, causing it to act friendlier toward you. The target attempts a Will save. It gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this save if you or your allies recently threatened or were {@condition hostile|PC1} to it.

Critical Success: The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.
