Success: The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charming touch, unless it identifies the spell (see Identifying Spells on page 303).
Failure: The target's attitude becomes {@condition friendly|PC1} toward you. If it was {@condition friendly|PC1}, it becomes {@condition helpful|PC1}. It can't use {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against you. If you use a {@condition hostile|PC1} action against the target, the spell ends. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell. After the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was {@condition charmed|PC1} unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations. If it doesn't realize you {@condition charmed|PC1} it, you could potentially convince it to continue being your friend via mundane means.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the target is {@condition helpful|PC1}.

name: Captivating Adoration
entries: You become intensely entrancing, and creatures are distracted by you as long as they remain within the area. You can exclude any creatures you choose from the effects. If a creature is in the aura when you Cast the Spell or when it enters the aura for the first time, it must attempt a Will saving throw. If a creature leaves and reenters, it uses the results of its original save.

Critical Success: The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 hour.
Success: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} with you for its next action, then is temporarily immune for 1 hour.
Failure: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} with you.
Critical Failure: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} with you, and its attitude toward you improves by one step.

1: Increase the size of the emanation by 15 feet.

name: Perfected Mind
entries: You meditate upon perfection to remove all distractions from your mind. Attempt a new Will save against one {@trait mental} effect currently affecting you that required a Will save. Use the result of this new save to determine the outcome of the {@trait mental} effect, unless the new save would have a worse result than the original save, in which case nothing happens. You can use perfected mind against a given effect only once.

name: Perfected Body
trigger: You fail or critically fail a saving throw against an effect that has the morph, {@trait poison}, or {@trait polymorph} trait, or that would make you {@condition clumsy|PC1}, {@condition doomed|PC1}, {@condition enfeebled|PC1}, {@condition petrified|PC1}, or {@condition sickened|PC1}.
entries: Your body's perfection keeps you just a little bit healthier than most. You get a failure if you rolled a critical failure or a success if you rolled a failure.

name: Protector's Sacrifice
trigger: An ally within 30 feet takes damage.
entries: You protect your ally by suffering in their stead. Reduce the damage the ally would take by 3. You redirect this damage to yourself, but your immunities, weaknesses, resistances and so on do not apply.

You aren't subject to any conditions or other effects of whatever damaged your ally (such as poison from a venomous bite). Your ally is still subject to those effects even if you redirect all of the triggering damage to yourself.

1: The damage you redirect increases by 3.

name: Protector's Sphere
entries: A protective aura emanates out from you, safeguarding you and your allies. You gain resistance 3 to all damage. Your allies also gain this resistance while in the aura.

1: The resistance increases by 1.

name: Whispering Quiet
entries: You suppress sound in an area, preventing anyone from giving away valuable secrets. This doesn't prevent those in the area from talking or Casting a Spell, but no creature more than 5 feet away can hear its voice without succeeding at a {@skill Perception|PC1} check against your spell DC, which might interfere with {@trait auditory} or {@trait linguistic} effects as well as communication. Other sounds created in the area are muffled to a similar volume unless that sound is created by an effect with the {@trait sonic} trait.

name: Safeguard Secret
targets: you and any number of willing allies
entries: You ensure a secret remains safe from prying spies. Choose one piece of information that at least some of the targets know, such as "the location of the stolen treasure" or "the password to enter the guild house. " The spell grants those who know the piece of knowledge you have chosen a +4 status bonus to skill checks (typically {@skill Deception|PC1} checks) to conceal this knowledge, to saving throws against spells that specifically attempt to obtain this knowledge from them, and to effects that would force them to reveal it. If you Cast this Spell again, any previous safeguard secret you had cast ends.

name: Dazzling Flash
entries: You raise your religious symbol and create a blinding flash of light. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.

Success: The creature is {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 round.
Failure: The creature is {@condition blinded|PC1} for 1 round and {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 minute. The creature can spend an {@action Interact|PC1} action rubbing its eyes to end the {@condition blinded|PC1} condition.
Critical Failure: The creature is {@condition blinded|PC1} for 1 round and {@condition dazzled|PC1} for 1 hour.

3: The area increases to a 30-foot cone.

name: Vital Luminance
entries: Drawing life force into yourself, you become a beacon of vitality.

You glow with bright light in a 30-foot emanation (and dim light to the next 30 feet), and you gain an internal pool of light called a luminance reservoir, which begins with a value of 4. At the start of each of your turns, increase your reservoir by 4.

If an {@trait undead} creature damages you with an attack or spell while it's within the bright light of your aura, that creature takes vitality damage equal to half your luminance reservoir value. It takes this damage only the first time it damages you in a round.

You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} this Spell. When you do, you can target a creature within your light and direct the vitality energy into it. The target must be a willing living creature or an {@trait undead} creature. This heals a living target or deals vitality damage to an undead target equal to your luminance reservoir's value.
If you Cast this Spell again, any previous casting ends.

1: Both the initial value of your luminance reservoir and the amount it increases each turn increase by 1.

name: Agile Feet
entries: The blessings of your god make your feet faster and your movements more fluid. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed and ignore difficult terrain. As part of casting agile feet, you can {@action Step|PC1}, {@action Stride|PC1}, or {@action Tumble Through|PC1}; you can instead {@action Burrow|PC1}, {@action Climb|PC1}, {@action Fly|PC1}, or {@action Swim|PC1} if you have the appropriate Speed.

name: Traveler's Transit
entries: You add power to your muscles, allowing you to swim or climb walls with ease. When you Cast this Spell, you gain either a climb Speed or a swim Speed. The Speed is equal to your land Speed.

5: You can choose to gain a fly Speed.

name: Sudden Shift
trigger: An enemy misses you with a melee attack.
entries: You swiftly move from a dangerous spot and veil yourself. You {@action Step|PC1} and become {@condition concealed|PC1}.

name: Trickster's Twin
entries: You rarely settle for being in just one place. Choose a location within 100 feet of the target that the target can see. You create an illusion of yourself there that only it can see and that mimics all your actions. The target must attempt a Will save.

Success: The target believes you're in the designated location and can't see you in your actual location. The target automatically disbelieves the illusion when you use an action that doesn't make sense in the illusion's position, or if the target attacks, touches, Seeks, or otherwise engages with the illusion. If you use a {@condition hostile|PC1} action against the target, the spell ends.
Failure: As success, but the target must succeed at a Will save to disbelieve the illusion when one of the listed events occurs.
Critical Failure: As success, but the target must critically succeed at a Will save to disbelieve when one of the listed events occurs.

name: Word of Truth
entries: You speak a statement that you believe to be true and that is free of any attempt to deceive through twisting words, omission, and so on. The statement must be 25 words or fewer. A symbol of your deity glows above your head and lasts for the spell's duration, and anyone who sees you and hears you speak knows instinctively that you believe what you say is true. This assurance of honesty grants you a +2 status bonus to {@skill Diplomacy|PC1} checks as long as the symbol persists. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell, and if you say something that you don't believe is entirely true, the spell ends before you complete your statement.

name: Glimpse the Truth
entries: Divine insight lets you see things as they are, unveiled by attempts to magically cloak the truth. The GM attempts a secret counteract check against each illusion that is at least partially within the area. Instead of counteracting the illusion, you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against an {@spell illusory disguise|PC1} spell, you see the creature's true form but illusory disguise doesn't end). Each time a new illusion comes into the aura during the duration of the spell, the GM attempts a secret counteract check for that illusion.

7: You can allow everyone within range of the emanation to see through any illusions you succeed against, not just yourself.

name: Touch of Obedience
entries: Your imperious touch erodes the target's willpower, making it easier to control. The target attempts a Will save. Regardless of the result, it's then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Success: The target is {@condition stupefied|PC1|stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn.
Failure: The target is {@condition stupefied|PC1|stupefied 2} until the end of your next turn.
Critical Failure: The target is {@condition stupefied|PC1|stupefied 2} for 1 minute and is forced to its knees, becoming {@condition prone|PC1}.

name: Commanding Lash
requirements: Your most recent action dealt damage to a target.
targets: a creature you dealt damage to on your most recent action
entries: With the threat of more pain, you compel a creature you've recently harmed. You issue a command to the target, with the effects of the spell command. If the target is {@condition frightened|PC1}, {@condition stupefied|PC1}, or taking {@condition persistent damage|PC1}, it takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the save. Regardless of the result, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

name: Touch of Undeath
entries: You attack the target's life force with undeath, dealing {@damage 1d6} void damage. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Success: The target takes half damage.
Failure: The target takes full damage, and {@trait vitality} effects heal it only half as much as normal for 1 round.
Critical Failure: The target takes double damage, and {@trait vitality} effects heal it only half as much as normal for 1 minute.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

name: Malignant Sustenance
entries: You embed a seed of void energy in an {@trait undead} creature, restoring its unnatural vigor over time. The target gains fast healing 7.

1: The fast healing increases by 2.

name: Tidal Surge
entries: You call forth a tremendous wave to move the target either in a body of water or on the ground. You move the target up to 10 feet in any direction along the ground or 20 feet through a body of water. An unwilling target can attempt a Fortitude save, and it avoids being moved if it succeeds.

name: Downpour
entries: You call forth a torrential downpour, which extinguishes nonmagical flames. Creatures in the area are {@condition concealed|PC1} and gain fire resistance 10. Creatures outside the area are {@condition concealed|PC1} to those inside the area. If a creature with weakness to water ends its turn in the area, the downpour triggers its weakness.

1: The fire resistance increases by 2.

name: Appearance of Wealth
entries: You create a brief vision of immense wealth filling the spell's area.

Each creature within 20 feet of the area that could be enticed by material wealth must attempt a Will saving throw. A creature that enters the area automatically disbelieves the illusion, and disbelieving the illusion ends any {@condition fascinated|PC1} condition imposed by the spell. As long as you {@action Sustain|PC1|Sustain the Spell}, other creatures react to the treasure like they would any other illusion, but they are not at risk of becoming {@condition fascinated|PC1}.

Critical Success: The creature disbelieves the illusion and is unaffected by it.
Success: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} by the wealth until it has completed its first action on its next turn.
Failure: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} by the illusion.

name: Precious Metals
targets: 1 metal shield or weapon, 1 suit of metal armor, or up to 1 Bulk of metal material (such as coins or metal-tipped ammunition)
entries: Your deity blesses base metals to transform them into precious materials. The metal in the target transforms from its normal metal into cold iron, copper, gold, iron, silver, or steel. If the spell's rank is 8th or higher, add adamantine and dawnsilver to the options. If you transform an object into copper, gold, or silver, its Hardness is reduced to 1. Otherwise, its Hardness is increased to 10 if it was lower. An item transmuted in this way deals damage according to its new material. For example, a steel sword transmuted to cold iron would deal additional damage to a creature with a weakness to cold iron. It can have other effects of the new material at the GM's discretion.
This change is clearly magical and temporary, so the item's monetary value doesn't change; you couldn't transmute copper coins to gold and use them to purchase something.

1: If you increase the Hardness of the object, the new Hardness is 2 higher.

name: Weapon Surge
entries: Holding your weapon aloft, you fill it with divine energy. On your next {@action Strike|PC1} with that weapon before the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to the attack roll, the weapon deals an additional {@damage 1d6} spirit damage, and the {@action Strike|PC1} gains the sanctified trait. Weapon surge ends once you complete this {@action Strike|PC1} or the weapon leaves your possession.

5: The attack deals {@dice 2d6} additional spirit damage.
9: The attack deals {@dice 3d6} additional spirit damage.

name: Zeal for Battle
trigger: You and at least 1 ally are about to roll initiative.
entries: You stoke the righteous anger within yourself and an ally. You and the target ally each roll a d20 and use the higher result for both your initiative rolls. You each still use your own {@skill Perception|PC1} modifier or other statistic to determine your results.

name: Primal Summons
entries: You enhance a {@trait summoned} creature with the power of the elements. If your next action is to cast either summon animal or summon plant or fungus, choose air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood; the creature you summon gains the corresponding abilities.

items: {@b Air} The creature gains a fly Speed of 60 feet.
{@b Earth} The creature gains a burrow Speed of 20 feet, reduces its land Speed by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet), and gains resistance 5 to physical damage.
{@b Fire} The creature's Strikes deal {@dice 1d6} extra fire damage, and it gains resistance 10 to fire and weakness 5 to cold and water.
{@b Metal} The creature's Strikes deal {@dice 1d6} extra electricity damage, and it gains resistance 5 to electricity.
{@b Water} The creature gains a swim Speed of 60 feet, can spend 1 action after a melee attack to attempt a {@action Shove|PC1} (ignoring multiple attack penalty), and gains resistance 5 to fire.
{@b Wood} The creature gains a climb Speed of 30 feet and resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage.

name: Heal Animal
entries: You heal an animal's wounds, restoring {@dice 1d8} Hit Points to the target. The number of actions spent Casting this Spell determines its effect.
{@as 1} The spell has a range of touch.
{@as 2} (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet and restores an additional 8 Hit Points to the target.

1: The amount of healing increases by {@dice 1d8}, and the additional healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

name: Cornucopia
entries: Vines twine into a wicker horn in your hands, and out spills a single fruit, nut, or similar small bit of produce. A creature who eats the produce with an {@action Interact|PC1} action regains {@dice 1d6+4} HP. The cornucopia, as well as any unconsumed pieces of fruit, wither away at the end of the duration.

1: The cornucopia produces an additional piece of food. A creature can consume any amount of food from the same casting with a single {@action Interact|PC1} action. Eating six pieces of produce from the cornucopia gives as much nourishment as one square meal for a typical human.

name: Impaling Briars
entries: The ground within the area transforms into a mass of dangerous briars that assault and impede your foes. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you {@action Sustain|PC1} it each turn on subsequent rounds, select one of the following effects to occur in the area.

items: {@b Ensnare} The briars clump around your foes, attempting to hold them in place. A foe within the area (or flying at most 20 feet above the area) must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds for 1 round, and on a critical failure, it is {@condition immobilized|PC1} for 1 round unless it Escapes.
{@b Impede} The briars twist and writhe, making the entire area difficult terrain.
{@b Wall} A wall of thorns appears in the area, lasting for 1 round. The wall is greater difficult terrain instead of difficult terrain.

entries: In addition, once per round you can direct the briars to impale any target in the area (or flying up to 20 feet above the area) that you can see by using a single action, which has the {@trait concentrate} and {@trait manipulate} traits. Make a spell attack roll. On a success, the target takes {@damage 10d6} piercing damage and takes a –10- foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds for 1 round; on a critical success, the target is {@condition immobilized|PC1} for 1 round unless it {@action Escape|PC1|Escapes}.

name: Storm Lord
entries: The sky above you darkens in a matter of moments, swirling with ominous clouds punctuated by flashes of lighting. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, select one of the following effects to occur in the area.

items: {@b Calm} No additional effect.
{@b Fog} Heavy fog rolls in, with the effects of mist.
{@b Rain} Torrential rain falls from the sky, dousing ordinary flames. Creatures in the area take a –2 circumstance penalty to {@skill Acrobatics|PC1} and {@skill Perception|PC1} checks.
{@b Wind} Powerful winds buffet the area in all directions.

entries: Ranged attacks take a –4 circumstance penalty, and the area is difficult terrain for flying creatures.

In addition, once per round you can use a single action, which has the {@trait concentrate} and {@trait manipulate} traits, to call down a bolt of lightning, striking any target in range that you can see. You deal {@damage 10d6} electricity damage to the target; it must attempt a basic Reflex save. On a failure, it is also {@condition deafened|PC1} for 1 round.

name: Stormwind Flight
entries: Powerful winds carry you through the air, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed. When this spell's duration would end, if you're still flying, you float to the ground, as gentle landing.

6: When you fly using stormwind flight, you ignore difficult terrain from wind.

name: Tempest Surge
entries: You surround a foe in a swirling storm of violent winds, roiling clouds, and crackling lightning. The storm deals {@damage 1d12} electricity damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, the target also is {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 2} for 1 round and takes 1 {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent electricity damage}.

1: The initial damage increases by {@damage 1d12}, and the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent electricity damage} on a failure increases by 1.

name: Untamed Form
entries: You reach within for a different part of yourself, and you set it free, transforming your body into another form. You polymorph into any form listed in {@spell pest form|PC1}, which lasts 10 minutes. All other untamed form shapes last 1 minute. You can add more shapes to your untamed form list with druid feats; your feat might grant you some or all of the shapes from a given {@trait polymorph} spell.

When you transform into a shape granted by a spell, you gain all the effects of the shape you chose from a version of the spell heightened to untamed form's rank. Untamed form allows you to use your own shapeshifting training more easily than most {@trait polymorph} spells. When you choose to use your own attack modifier while polymorphed instead of the form's default attack modifier, you gain a +2 status bonus to your attack rolls.

2: You can transform into shapes listed in {@spell animal form|PC1}.

name: Untamed Shift
entries: You transform just a part of your body. Choose any one effect that matches an untamed order feat you have.

items: {@b {@feat Untamed Form|PC1}} Your hands transform into incredibly sharp claws. Untamed claws are an unarmed attack, have the {@trait agile} and {@trait finesse} traits, and deal {@damage 1d6} slashing damage. You can still hold and use items with your hands while they're transformed by this spell, but you must have a hand free to attack with it.
{@b {@feat Insect Shape|PC1}} Your mouth becomes deadly jaws. Untamed jaws are an unarmed attack that deal {@damage 1d8} piercing damage.
{@b {@feat Elemental Shape|PC1}} You shift your body to be partially composed of elemental matter, granting you resistance 5 to critical hits and precision damage.
{@b {@feat Plant Shape|PC1}} Your arms become long vines, increasing your reach to 10 feet (or 15 feet with a reach weapon).
{@b {@feat Soaring Shape|PC1}} You must cast untamed shift using 2 actions for this benefit. You grow wings from your back, gaining a fly Speed of 30 feet.

6: You can choose up to two effects from the list. Untamed claws leave terrible, ragged wounds that also deal {@damage 2d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} on a hit, and untamed jaws are envenomed, also dealing {@damage 2d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage} on a hit.
10: You can choose up to three effects from the list. Untamed claws deal {@damage 4d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} on a hit, and untamed jaws deal {@damage 4d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage} on a hit.

name: Gravity Weapon
entries: You build up gravitational force and funnel it into your blows, leading to more powerful attacks with blade and bow alike. On your first weapon {@action Strike|PC1} each round, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice.

name: Heal Companion
entries: You heal your animal companion's wounds. You restore {@dice 1d10} Hit Points to your animal companion. The number of actions you spend Casting this Spell determines range and other parameters.
{@as 1} (manipulate) The spell has a range of touch.
{@as 2} (concentrate, manipulate) The spell has a range of 30 feet and restores an additional 8 Hit Points to the target.

1: The amount of healing increases by {@dice 1d10}, and the additional healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

name: Magic Hide
entries: Your animal companion grows a thicker hide, matted fur, or a harder shell, granting it a +1 status bonus to AC.

name: Animal Feature
entries: Without fully transforming your body, you gain one animalistic feature, which you select from the list below each time you Cast the Spell.

items: {@b Cat} Eyes You gain low-light vision.
{@b Claws} You gain a claw attack that deals {@damage 1d6} slashing damage and has the agile, {@trait finesse}, and {@trait unarmed} traits.
{@b Jaws} You gain a jaws attack that deals {@damage 1d8} piercing damage and has the {@trait unarmed} trait.

4: Add the following options to the list.

items: {@b Fish Tail} You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.
{@b Owl Eyes} You gain darkvision.
{@b Wings} You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Enlarge Companion
entries: Your animal companion grows much larger, towering over its foes in battle. Your animal companion becomes Large, gaining the effects of a 2nd-rank {@spell enlarge|PC1} spell.

4: Your animal companion instead becomes Huge, gaining the benefits of a 4th-rank {@spell enlarge|PC1} spell.

name: Hunter's Luck
trigger: You attempt a check to {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1} about a creature, but you haven't rolled yet.
entries: You have a preternatural ability to remember details about your foes. Roll the triggering check twice and use the better result.

name: Soothing Mist
targets: 1 willing living creature or 1 {@trait undead} creature
entries: You call forth a magical mist that envelops a creature. The mist restores {@dice 2d8} Hit Points to a target living creature and ends one source of {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent acid}, bleed, fire, poison, or void damage affecting it. If the creature is taking {@condition persistent damage|PC1} from multiple sources, you select which one is removed. Against an undead target, you deal {@damage 2d8} vitality damage (basic Fortitude save); if it fails the save, it also takes 2 {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent vitality damage}.

1: The amount of healing (or damage to an undead target) increases by {@dice 1d8}, and the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent vitality damage} to an {@trait undead} creature increases by 1.

name: Ephemeral Tracking
entries: You can look at currents in the air and water and see tracks that you can follow just as you would on land. You can use {@skill Survival|PC1} to {@action Track|PC1} through both air and water, noticing aerial or aquatic "tracks" of all creatures who passed nearby in the last hour. It's more difficult to {@action Track|PC1} in this way: the DC to {@action Track|PC1} through air or water is always at least 30, or higher after precipitation or wind (in the air) or heavy tides or currents (in the water). It's possible to {@action Cover Tracks|PC1} against this spell, but creatures might not realize they need to do so.

name: Ranger's Bramble

area.entry: all squares that contain plants in a 5-foot burst

entries: You cause plants in the area to entangle your foes, with the effects of entangling flora. A creature that critically fails the save takes {@damage 2d4} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} in addition to being {@condition immobilized|PC1}. Escaping your bramble doesn't end the bleed damage.

1: The bleed damage on a critical failure increases by {@dice 1d4}.

name: Hunter's Vision
entries: Your target glows with a magical aura visible only to you and those who follow your lead. Your target is visible to you and others sharing your {@action Hunt Prey|PC1} benefits even if it wouldn't normally be due to lighting or the {@condition concealed|PC1} or {@condition invisible|PC1} conditions, though cover from opaque objects still blocks your sight. You ignore the flat check against the target due to the {@condition concealed|PC1} condition, and the target isn't automatically {@condition hidden|PC1} from you due to darkness or being {@condition invisible|PC1}.

name: Terrain Transposition
entries: You mystically transpose your current location with another. While in a wilderness environment, you transport yourself and items you're holding to a clear space you can see within range.

If you have {@feat Favored Terrain|PC1} and both your starting and ending position are in your favored terrain, the range increases to 180 feet. If you have an animal companion and it is adjacent to you, you can transport it along with you to an adjacent open space, but if this spell would bring any other creature with you, even in an extradimensional container, the spell is lost.

name: Blood Ward
entries: Your patron's aegis descends to shield a target from harm. Designate one of the following creature traits: {@trait aberration}, {@trait animal}. The target gains a +1 status bonus to its saving throws and AC against creatures with that trait.

5: The status bonus increases to +2.

name: Cackle
entries: With a quick burst of laughter, you prolong a {@trait magical} effect you created. You {@action Sustain|PC1} a spell.

name: Curse of Death
entries: Your patron wraps a hand around your target's heart. The target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to all curses of death for 1 day.

Success: The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 1, and the stage of the curse can't increase beyond stage 1.
Failure: The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 1.
Critical Failure: The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 2.

entries.name: Curse of Death
entries.note: This curse ends immediately when the spell ends

1: Increase the void damage taken on a success and during the first three stages of the curse by {@dice 1d6}.

name: Deceiver's Cloak
entries: Your patron drapes a cloak of illusion about you, making you appear as another creature of the same body shape with roughly similar height and weight as yourself. This has the effects of 3rd-rank {@spell illusory disguise|PC1}.

6: You can appear as any creature of the same size, even with a completely different body shape.

name: Elemental Betrayal
entries: Your patron uses its superior command of the elements, empowering them to undermine your foe. When you Cast this Spell, choose {@trait air}, {@trait earth}, {@trait metal}, {@trait fire}, {@trait water}, or {@trait wood}. The target gains weakness 2 to that trait.

2: Increase the weakness by 1.

name: Life Boost
entries: Life force from your patron floods into the target, ensuring they can continue doing your patron's will for just a little longer. The target gains fast healing 2.

1: The fast healing increases by 2.

name: Malicious Shadow
entries: Your patron warps the target's shadow into a deadly form, such as strangling hands, a dangerous weapon, harrying runes, or the like. The shadow moves along with the target, always remaining within reach. When you Cast the Spell, and each time you {@action Sustain|PC1} it, the shadow {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} the target. The shadow's {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} are melee spell attacks that deal damage equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your spellcasting attribute modifier. You choose the type of damage (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) when you Cast the Spell. The shadow uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty.
The shadow doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The shadow can't make any attacks other than its {@action Strike|PC1}.

The shadow vanishes if the target ceases to cast a shadow (usually if it moves into complete darkness or light). If another effect is controlling the target's shadow when you cast {@spell malicious shadow|PC1}, you can attempt to counteract that effect to temporarily take control of the shadow for malicious shadow's duration.

2: The {@action Strike|PC1} damage increases by {@damage 1d10}.

name: Needle of Vengeance
entries: A long, jagged needle jabs into the target foe's psyche whenever it tries to attack a creature your patron holds in special regard.
Name yourself or one of your allies. The target takes 2 mental damage any time it uses a {@condition hostile|PC1} action against the named creature, with a basic Will save.

1: Increase the damage by 2.

name: Patron's Puppet
trigger: Your turn begins.
entries: At your unspoken plea, your patron temporarily assumes control over your familiar. You Command your familiar, allowing it to take its normal actions this turn. Your Command does not have the {@trait auditory} or {@trait concentrate} traits; your patron simply moves its agent directly.

name: Personal Blizzard
entries: Your patron's breath becomes a blizzard of obscuring, scouring ice that follows your target. The target attempts a Fortitude save.

Success: The target takes {@damage 1d6} cold damage, and the spell ends.
Failure: The target takes {@damage 1d6} cold damage and {@damage 1d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent cold damage}. The {@condition persistent damage|PC1} automatically ends when the spell ends. It is {@condition concealed|PC1} to other creatures, and other creatures are {@condition concealed|PC1} to it.
Critical Failure: As failure, but both the cold damage and the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent cold damage} are {@dice 2d6}.

1: The cold damage and {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent cold damage} increase by 1 (2 on a critical failure).

name: Phase Familiar
trigger: Your familiar would take damage.
entries: Your patron momentarily recalls your familiar to the ether, shifting it from its solid, physical form into a ghostly version of itself. Against the triggering damage, your familiar gains resistance 5 to all damage and is immune to precision damage.

1: Increase the resistance by 2.

name: Restorative Moment
entries: Your patron weaves the threads of time around the target, giving them some of the benefits of a day's passage. The target decreases the values of any {@condition doomed|PC1} and {@condition drained|PC1} conditions it has by 1 and can immediately attempt one saving throw against each affliction it has with a stage length of 1 day or less. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 day.

name: Veil of Dreams
entries: Your patron draws the target into a drowsy state, causing daydreams and sluggishness. The target must attempt a Will save.

Success: The target takes a –1 status penalty to {@skill Perception|PC1}, attack rolls, and Will saves. This penalty increases to –2 for Will saves against {@trait sleep} effects.
Failure: As success, and any time the target uses a concentrate action, it must succeed at a DC {@flatDC 5} flat check or the action is disrupted.

name: Clinging Ice
entries: Freezing sleet and heavy snowfall collect on the target's feet and legs, dealing {@damage 1d4} cold damage and other effects depending on its Reflex save.

Success: The target takes half damage.
Failure: The target takes full damage and a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the spell ends.
Critical Failure: The target takes double damage and a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the spell ends.

1: The damage increases by {@damage 1d4}.

name: Discern Secrets
entries: Your patron deigns to whisper a few secrets. The target can {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1}, {@action Seek|PC1}, or {@action Sense Motive|PC1} as a free action. The target gains a +1 status bonus to the statistic used for the roll (a skill or {@skill Perception|PC1}) on the roll and as long as you {@action Sustain|PC1} the spell. The target is temporarily immune to discern secrets for 1 minute.

5: You can target two creatures instead of one.

name: Evil Eye
entries: Your patron's resentment manifests in a baleful, envious gaze. The target becomes {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 1} if it fails a Will save (or {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 2} on a critical failure). This condition value can't be reduced below 1 while the spell is active and you can see the target.

name: Nudge Fate
entries: The barest spin of your patron's spool is enough to alter fate.

When the target fails an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw and a +1 status bonus would turn a critical failure into a failure, or failure into a success, you grant the target a +1 status bonus to the check retroactively, changing the outcome appropriately. The spell then ends.
If you cast {@spell nudge fate|PC1} while a previous casting of this hex is still in effect, the previous effect ends.

name: Shroud of Night
entries: Your patron blankets the target's eyes in darkness. If you cast this hex on a willing ally (for instance, one with light blindness), the ally can choose which result it gets without rolling.

Success: The target is unaffected.
Failure: The target is shrouded in murky darkness. It treats bright light as dim light, and unless it has greater darkvision, all creatures are {@condition concealed|PC1} to it.

name: Stoke the Heart
entries: Your patron fills a creature with fervor, empowering their blows. The target gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls.

2: The status bonus to damage increases by 1.

name: Wilding Word
entries: Your patron's majesty—or their displeasure—comes in a growl from your throat, making other creatures reluctant to harm you.
The target must attempt a Will save; if the creature is an {@trait animal}, {@trait fungus}, or {@trait plant}, it takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its save.

Success: When the target attempts an attack roll or skill check that would harm you, it takes a –2 status penalty to its roll.
Failure: As success, but the target also becomes {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 1} each time it damages you.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the {@condition sickened|PC1} value is 2

name: Protective Wards
entries: You expand a ring of glyphs that shields your allies. You and any allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to AC. Each time you {@action Sustain|PC1|Sustain the Spell}, the emanation's radius increases by 5 feet, to a maximum of 30 feet.

name: Rune of Observation
entries: You inscribe an {@condition invisible|PC1} eye-shaped rune in the air, creating a sensor as {@spell clairvoyance|PC1}. When created, this eye must be in your line of sight.
Each time the spell's duration ends, you can spend 1 Focus Point as a free action to extend the duration for another hour, though as normal, it ends immediately during your next daily preparations.

name: Force Bolt
entries: You fire an arrow-shaped bolt of force, one of the most common and reliable forms of battle magic. It automatically hits and deals {@damage 1d4+1} force damage to the target.

2: The damage increases by {@damage 1d4+1}.

name: Energy Absorption
trigger: An effect would deal acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage to you.
entries: You're used to mitigating the damage done by bombs, siege engines, and magical artillery. You gain resistance 15 to your choice of acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage from the triggering effect. The resistance applies only to the triggering effect's initial damage.

1: The resistance increases by 5.

name: Fortify Summoning
entries: As you call a creature to your side, your magic transforms its body, heightening its ferocity and fortifying its resilience.
The target gains a +1 status bonus to all checks and DCs (including its AC) for the duration of its summoning, up to 1 minute.

name: Spiral of Horrors
entries: Shades and spirits howl and whirl around you in a display that strikes fear into the hearts of all who witness it. Enemies in the area are {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1} and can't reduce their {@condition frightened|PC1} value below 1 for the spell's duration.

name: Earthworks
entries: With a ripple of earth, you raise small barriers from the ground. The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain. The spell's area is a 5-foot burst if you spent 1 action to cast it, a 10-foot burst if you spent 2 actions, or a 15-foot burst if you spent 3 actions. A creature can {@action Interact|PC1} to clear the barriers from one 5-foot square adjacent to it.

4: You pull the barriers to float in the air, causing the spell to function as difficult terrain for flying creatures.

name: Community Restoration
trigger: You Cast a Spell from a wizard spell slot, and the spell affects one or more willing allies without damaging them.
entries: When you use your magic to support your allies, shared strength bolsters you all. You gain 2 temporary Hit Points per rank of the triggering spell, and can grant an equal number divided as you choose among allies affected by the triggering spell. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Charming Push
entries: You push at the target's mind to deflect their ire. The target must attempt a Will save.

Success: The target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls against you.
Failure: The target can't use {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against you.
Critical Failure: The target is {@condition stunned|PC1|stunned 1} and can't use {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against you.

name: Invisibility Cloak
entries: You become {@condition invisible|PC1}, with the same restrictions as the 2nd-rank {@spell invisibility|PC1} spell.

6: The duration increases to 10 minutes.
8: The duration increases to 1 hour.

name: Scramble Body
entries: Your magic throws the creature's biology into disarray, inducing nausea, fever, and other unpleasant conditions.

Success: The target is unaffected.
Failure: The target becomes {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 1}.
Critical Failure: The target becomes {@condition sickened|PC1|sickened 2} and {@condition slowed|PC1|slowed 1} as long as it's {@condition sickened|PC1}.

name: Shifting Form
entries: You change your body to better suit the moment. You gain one of the following abilities of your choice. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} this spell.

items: You gain a 20-foot status bonus to your Speed.
You gain a climb or swim Speed equal to half your Speed.
You gain darkvision.
You gain a pair of claws. These are agile finesse unarmed attacks that deal {@damage 1d8} slashing damage.
You gain scent 60 feet (imprecise).

name: Hand of the Apprentice
entries: You take advantage of one of the most fundamental lessons of magic to levitate and propel your weapon. You hurl a held melee weapon with which you are trained at the target, making a spell attack roll. On a success, you deal the weapon's damage as if you had hit with a melee {@action Strike|PC1}, but add your spellcasting attribute modifier to damage, rather than your Strength modifier. On a critical success, you deal double damage, and you add the weapon's critical specialization effect. Regardless of the outcome, the weapon flies back to you and returns to your hand.

name: Interdisciplinary Incantation
trigger: A creature within 30 feet casts an {@trait arcane} spell.
entries: You gather the embers of another caster's spell, using your understanding of unified magic to pick apart their formulas and incantations well enough to imitate the spell yourself, if only for a short time. Until the end of your next turn, you can Cast the triggering Spell by expending a wizard spell slot of the same rank. That caster's spells can't trigger your {@spell interdisciplinary incantation|PC1} again for 24 hours.

name: Acid Grip
entries: An ephemeral, taloned hand grips the target, burning it with magical acid. The target takes {@damage 2d8} acid damage plus {@damage 1d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent acid damage} depending on its Reflex save. A creature taking {@condition persistent damage|PC1} from this spell takes a –10-foot status bonus to its Speeds.

entries.Success: The creature takes half damage and no {@condition persistent damage|PC1}, and the claw moves it up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice.
entries.Failure: The creature takes full damage and {@condition persistent damage|PC1}, and the claw moves it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
entries.Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage and full {@condition persistent damage|PC1}, and the claw moves it up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice.

2: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|4,6,8,10|2d8}, and the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent acid damage} increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|4,6,8,10|1d6}.

name: Aerial Form
entries: You harness your mastery of primal forces to reshape your body into a Medium flying animal battle form. When you cast this spell, choose bat, bird, pterosaur, or wasp. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as an owl or eagle for bird), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the {@trait animal} trait. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

items: AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
5 temporary Hit Points.
Low-light vision.

One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can {@action Strike|PC1} with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +16, and your damage bonus is +5. These attacks are Dexterity based (for the purpose of the {@condition clumsy|PC1} condition, for example). If your attack modifier for Dexterity-based unarmed attacks is higher, you can use it instead.
{@skill Acrobatics|PC1} modifier of +16, unless your own modifier is higher.

entries: You also gain specific abilities based on the form you choose:

items: {@bold Bat} Speed 20 feet, fly Speed 30 feet; precise echolocation 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} fangs, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d8} piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} wing ({@trait agile}), {@b Damage} {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning.
{@bold Bird} Speed 10 feet, fly Speed 50 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} beak, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d8} piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} talon ({@trait agile}), {@b Damage} {@damage 1d10} slashing.
{@bold Pterosaur} Speed 10 feet, fly Speed 40 feet; imprecise {@ability scent} 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} beak, {@b Damage} {@damage 3d6} piercing.
{@bold Wasp} Speed 20 feet, fly Speed 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} stinger, {@b Damage} {@damage 1d8} piercing plus {@damage 1d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison}.

5: Your battle form is Large and your fly Speed gains a +10-foot status bonus. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. You instead gain 10 temporary HP, attack modifier +18, damage bonus +8, and {@skill Acrobatics|PC1} +20.
6: Your battle form is Huge, your fly Speed gains a +15-foot status bonus, and your attacks have 10-foot reach. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary HP, attack modifier +21, damage bonus +4 and double damage dice (including {@condition persistent damage|PC1}), and {@skill Acrobatics|PC1} +23.

name: Air Bubble
trigger: A creature within range enters an environment where it can't breathe.
entries: A bubble of pure air appears around the target's head, allowing it to breathe normally. The effect ends as soon as the target returns to an environment where it can breathe normally.

name: Alarm
entries: You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast {@spell alarm|PC1}, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the {@trait mental} trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the {@trait auditory} trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a DC 15 {@skill Perception|PC1} check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a {@skill Stealth|PC1} check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.

3: You can specify criteria for which creatures sound the {@spell alarm|PC1} spell—for instance, orcs or masked people.

name: Animal Form
entries: You call upon primal energy to transform yourself into a Medium animal battle form. When you first cast this spell, choose ape, bear, bull, canine, cat, deer, frog, shark, or snake. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as lion or snow leopard for cat), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the {@trait animal} trait. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

items: AC = 16 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
5 temporary Hit Points.
{@ability Low-light vision} and imprecise {@ability scent} 30 feet.

One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can {@action Strike|PC1} with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +9, and your damage bonus is +1. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the {@condition enfeebled|PC1} condition, for example). If your unarmed attack bonus is higher, you can use it instead.
{@skill Athletics|PC1} modifier of +9, unless your own modifier is higher.

entries: You also gain specific abilities based on the type of animal you choose:

items: {@bold Ape} Speed 25 feet, climb Speed 20 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} fist, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning.
{@bold Bear} Speed 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d8} piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} claw ({@trait agile}), {@b Damage} {@damage 1d8} slashing.
{@bold Bull} Speed 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} horn, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d8} piercing.
{@bold Canine} Speed 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d8} piercing.
{@bold Cat} Speed 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d6} piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} claw ({@trait agile}), {@b Damage} {@damage 1d10} slashing.
{@bold Deer} Speed 50 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} antler, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d6} piercing.

{@bold Frog} Speed 25 feet, swim Speed 25 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning; {@b Melee} {@as 1} tongue ({@trait reach <15 feet>}), {@b Damage} {@damage 2d4} bludgeoning.
{@bold Shark} swim Speed 35 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d8} piercing; breathe underwater but not in air.
{@bold Snake} Speed 20 feet, climb Speed 20 feet, swim Speed 20 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} fangs, {@b Damage} {@damage 2d4} piercing plus {@damage 1d6} poison.

3: You instead gain 10 temporary HP, AC = 17 + your level, attack modifier +14, damage bonus +5, and {@skill Athletics|PC1} +14.
4: Your battle form is Large and your attacks have 10-foot reach. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. You instead gain 15 temporary HP, AC = 18 + your level, attack modifier +16, damage bonus +9, and {@skill Athletics|PC1} +16.
5: Your battle form is Huge and your attacks have 15-foot reach. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. You instead gain 20 temporary HP, AC = 18 + your level, attack modifier +18, damage bonus +7 and double the number of damage dice, and {@skill Athletics|PC1} +20.

name: Animal Messenger
entries: You offer a gift of food, and an ordinary Tiny wild animal within range approaches to eat it. You imprint the image, direction, and distance of an obvious place or landmark well known to you within the animal. Optionally, you can attach a small object or note up to light Bulk to it. The animal does its best to reach the destination; if it makes it there, it waits nearby until the duration expires, allowing other nonhostile creatures to approach it and remove the attached object. The spell ends after 24 hours or when a creature removes the attached object, whichever happens first.
If there are no Tiny wild animals in range, the spell is lost.

name: Ant Haul
entries: You reinforce the target's musculoskeletal system to bear more weight. The target can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming {@condition encumbered|PC1} and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

name: Aqueous Orb
entries: A sphere of water 10 feet in diameter forms in an unoccupied space in range, either on the ground or on the surface of a liquid. When you Cast this Spell and each time you {@action Sustain|PC1} it, you can roll the orb, moving it up to 10 feet along the ground or the surface of a liquid. The orb can move through the spaces of any creatures or obstacles that wouldn't stop the flow of water. It extinguishes non-magical fires it moves through of its size or smaller, and it attempts to counteract any magical fires it moves through. If it fails to counteract a given fire, it can't counteract that fire for the duration of the spell.

The orb can engulf Large or smaller creatures it moves through, and it can contain as many creatures as fit in its space. The orb can try to engulf the same creature only once per turn, even if you roll it onto a creature's space more than once. Any Large or smaller creature whose space the orb tries to move through can attempt a Reflex save.

entries.Success: The creature can either let the orb pass (remaining in its space or moving out of the orb's path into a space of the creature's choice) or allow itself to be pushed in front of the orb to the end of the orb's movement.
entries.Failure: The creature is engulfed in the orb. It moves along with the orb and must hold its breath or begin suffocating (unless it can breathe in water). An engulfed Medium or smaller creature and anyone trying to affect that creature follow the normal rules for aquatic battles. An engulfed Large creature is usually big enough that parts of it stick out from the water, and it can reach out of the water. The creature can get free either by Swimming with a successful DC 10 Athletics check or by Escaping against your spell DC. A freed creature exits the orb's space and can immediately breathe.
entries.Critical Failure: As failure, but the creature can't Swim to get free.

name: Arctic Rift
entries: A jagged crack opens in the air, dealing {@damage 12d8} cold damage as it draws away warmth. Each creature along the rift must attempt a Fortitude save

entries.Success: The creature takes half damage.
entries.Failure: The creature takes full damage and is {@condition Slowed|PC1|slowed 1} until the start of your next turn.
entries.Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage, is {@condition Immobilized|PC1|immobilized} by a layer of ice, and is {@condition Slowed|PC1|slowed 1} as long as its immobilized.  The ice is an object with 60 Hit Points, Hardness 5, immunity to cold damage, and vulnerability 10 to fire.  It has object immunity and is destroyed if the target {@action Escape|PC1|Escapes}.

1: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 12d8|8,9,10|1d8}. and the ice's Hit Points increase by 5

name: Augury
entries: You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret DC {@flatDC 6} flat check. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

name: Avatar
entries: You transform into an avatar of your deity, assuming a {@trait Huge} battle form. You must have space to expand or the spell is lost.
You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} this spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which deity's battle form you assume:

items: AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
30 temporary Hit Points.
{@ability Darkvision}.

One or more attacks specific to your deity's battle form, which are the only attacks you can {@action Strike|PC1} with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +33, and you use the listed damage. Melee attacks are Strength based (for the purposes of the {@condition enfeebled|PC1} condition, for example) unless they have the {@trait finesse} trait, and all ranged attacks are Dexterity based. Attacks that deal vitality or void damage don't heal creatures.
{@skill Athletics|PC1} modifier of +35, unless your own is higher.

entries: You also gain the specific abilities listed for your deity below:

items: {@note You can see all {@filter deities battle forms|deities||Miscellaneous=Has Battle Form} on the {@pf2etools Deities|deities.html} page.}

name: Bane
entries: You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Targets that fail their Will saves take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can {@action Sustain|PC1} the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw. Bane can counteract {@spell bless|PC1}.

name: Banishment
targets: 1 creature that isn't on its home plane
entries: You send the target back to its home plane. The target must attempt a Will save. You can spend an extra action while Casting this Spell and add a material component to give the creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save. The component must be a specially gathered object that is anathema to the creature, and not from a spell component pouch. This spell fails if you aren't on your home plane when you cast it.

entries.Critical Success: The target resists being banished and you are {@condition stunned 1|PC1}.
entries.Success: The target resists being banished.
entries.Failure: The target is banished.
entries.Critical Failure: The target is banished and can't return by any means to the plane it's banished from for 1 week.

9: You can target up to 10 creatures. The extra material component affects targets to which it is anathema.

name: Bind Undead
targets: 1 mindless undead creature with a level no greater than bind undead's spell level
entries: With a word of necromantic power, you seize control of the target. It gains the minion trait. If you or an ally uses any {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against the target, the spell ends.

name: Blazing Bolt
entries: You fire a ray of heat and flame. Make a spell attack roll against a single creature. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d6} fire damage, and on a critical hit, the target takes double damage.

For each additional action you use when {@action Cas Spell|PC1|Casting the Spell}, you can fire an additional ray at a different target, to a maximum of three rays targeting three different targets for 3 actions. These attacks each increase your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after you make all the spell attack rolls for blazing bolt. If you spend 2 or more actions Casting the Spell, the damage increases to {@damage 4d6} fire damage on a hit, and it still deals double damage on a critical hit.

1: The damage to each target increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-10|1d6} for the 1-action version, or by {@scaledamage 4d6|2-10|2d6} for the 2-action and 3-action versions.

name: Bless
entries: Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can {@action Sustain|PC1} the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet. Bless can counteract {@spell bane|PC1}.

name: Blessed Boundary
entries: Manifestations of divine force appear in the hundreds, swirling in a massive, protective sphere. These typically look like spiky fragments, but often take on an appearance themed to the deity of the caster. The sphere is hollow, with the manifestations forming a shell 2 inches deep on the outer edge. You can choose to make the burst smaller, in 5-foot increments, when you cast it.

The shell provides cover and can intersect solid terrain without affecting it. The shell deals {@damage 7d8} force damage to each creature who intersects with the shell when the sphere's created, or who attempts to move through the shell. The creature also takes the damage at the end of its turn, but only if it didn't already take damage from the shell that turn. The effects are determined by a creature's Reflex save.

entries.Success: The creature takes half damage.
entries.Failure: The creature takes full damage and is pushed up to 10 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.
entries.Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage, is pushed up to 20 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.

1: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 7d8|6-10|1d8}.

name: Blindness
entries: You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

entries.Success: The target is {@condition blinded|PC1} until its next turn begins.
entries.Failure: The target is {@condition blinded|PC1} for 1 minute.
entries.Critical Failure: The target is {@condition blinded|PC1} permanently.

name: Blood Vendetta
trigger: A creature deals piercing, slashing, or {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} to you
entries: You curse the target, punishing it for having the audacity to spill your blood. The target takes {@damage 2d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} and must attempt a Will save.

entries.Success: The target takes half the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage}.
entries.Failure: The target takes the full {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage}. Until the bleeding stops, the target has weakness 1 to piercing and slashing damage.
entries.Critical Failure: As failure, but the target takes double the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage}.

2: The {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} increases by {@dice 2d6}.

name: Blur
entries: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes {@condition concealed|PC1}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to {@action Hide|PC1} or {@action Sneak|PC1}.

name: Breath of Life
trigger: A living creature within range would die.
entries: Your blessing revives a creature at the moment of its death. You prevent the target from {@condition dying|PC1} and restore {@dice 5d8} Hit Points to the target. You can't use breath of life if the triggering effect was {@spell disintegrate|PC1} or a {@trait death} effect.

2: The healing increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|5,7,9|1d8}.

name: Breathe Fire
entries: A gout of flame sprays from your mouth. You deal {@damage 2d6} fire damage to creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save.

1: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-10|2d6}.

name: Calm
entries: You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

entries.Success: Calming urges impose a –1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.
entries.Failure: Any {@trait emotion} effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use {@condition hostile|PC1} actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm emotions.
entries.Critical Failure: As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

name: Canticle of Everlasting Grief
entries: You create a melody distilled from pure grief, conveying the inevitable loss of everything your target cherishes, audible to only them. The target takes {@damage 10d6} mental damage depending on its Will save. A creature cursed by this spell can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses, for the duration noted in the degree of success.

entries.Success: The target takes half damage, is {@condition frightened 1|PC1}, and is cursed for one round.
entries.Failure: The target takes full damage, is {@condition frightened 3|PC1}, and is cursed for 1 week.
entries.Critical Failure: The target takes double damage and is {@condition frightened 4|PC1}, and is cursed for an unlimited duration. While the curse remains, the target's allies are also affected by the curse while within 15 feet of the creature.

name: Cataclysm
entries: You call upon the unimaginable power of world-ending cataclysms, ripping a small piece of each cataclysm and combining them together into one horrifically powerful attack.

The following effects come down upon all creatures in the area. Treat the resistances of creatures in the area as if they were 10 lower for the purpose of determining the cataclysm's damage. Each creature attempts one basic Reflex save that applies to all six types of damage.

items: Flesh-dissolving acid rain deals {@damage 3d10} acid damage.
A roaring earthquake shakes and bludgeons creatures on the ground, dealing {@damage 3d10} bludgeoning damage.
A blast of freezing wind deals {@damage 3d10} cold damage.
Incredible lightning lashes the area, dealing {@damage 3d10} electricity damage.
Beating winds churn across the sky, dealing {@damage 3d10} bludgeoning damage to creatures flying in the area.
An instant tsunami sweeps over creatures in the area, dealing {@damage 3d10} bludgeoning damage with the {@trait water} trait (doubled for creatures swimming in the area).
A massive wildfire burns in a sudden inferno, dealing {@damage 3d10} fire damage.

name: Caustic Blast
entries: You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take {@damage 1d8} acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes 1 {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent acid damage}.

2: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|1,3,5,7,9|1d8}, and the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent damage} on a critical failure increases by 1.

name: Chain Lightning
targets: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures
entries: You discharge a powerful bolt of lightning at the target, dealing {@damage 8d12} electricity damage. The target must attempt a basic Reflex save. The electricity arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the chain at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome). The chain ends if any one of the targets critically succeeds at its save.

1: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d12|6-10|1d12}.

name: Charm
entries: To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against it.

You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell. If you use {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

entries.Critical Success: The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.
entries.Success: The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell (see Identifying Spells on page 305).
entries.Failure: The target's attitude becomes {@condition friendly|PC1} toward you. If it was {@condition friendly|PC1}, it becomes {@condition helpful|PC1}. It can't use {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against you.
entries.Critical Failure: The target's attitude becomes {@condition helpful|PC1} toward you, and it can't use {@condition hostile|PC1} actions against you.

4: The duration lasts until your next daily preparations.
8: The duration lasts until your next daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Chilling Darkness
entries: You shoot an utterly cold ray of darkness tinged with unholy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals {@damage 5d6} cold damage.  If the target has the {@trait holy} trait, you deal an extra {@damage 5d6} spirit damage.

entries.Success: The target takes full damage.

entries: If the ray passes through an area of magical light or targets a creature affected by magical light, chilling darkness attempts to {@quickref counteract||3|counteracting} the light. If you need to determine whether the ray passes through an area of light, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

1: The cold damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d6|3-10|2d6}, and the spirit damage against holy creatures increases by {@scaledamage 5d6|3-10|2d6}.

name: Clairaudience
entries: You create an {@condition invisible|PC1} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

name: Clairvoyance
entries: You create an {@condition invisible|PC1} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

name: Cleanse Affliction
entries: Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an {@quickref affliction||3|afflictions} on the target, such as a {@trait curse}, {@trait disease}, or {@trait poison}. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to {@quickref counteract||3|counteracting} with each casting.

3: Attempt to {@quickref counteract||3|counteracting} the affliction if it is a {@trait disease} or {@trait poison}.
4: Attempt to {@quickref counteract||3|counteracting} the affliction if it is a {@trait curse}, {@trait disease} or {@trait poison}.

name: Cleanse Cuisine
entries: You transform all food and beverages in the area into delicious fare, changing water into wine or another fine beverage, or enhancing the food's taste and ingredients to make it a gourmet treat. You can also choose to remove all toxins and contaminations from the food. This spell doesn't prevent future contamination, natural decay, or spoilage, nor does it make the food any more nutritious.

2: Add another cubic foot to the area, which must be contiguous with the rest.

name: Clear Mind
entries: You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to {@quickref counteract||3|counteracting} an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: {@condition fleeing|PC1}, {@condition frightened|PC1}, and {@condition stupefied|PC1}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of {@trait curse||curses}, {@trait disease||diseases}, or a natural state of the target.

4: Add {@condition confused|PC1}, {@condition controlled|PC1}, and {@condition slowed|PC1} to the list of conditions.
6: Add {@condition doomed|PC1} to the list of conditions.
8: Add {@condition stunned|PC1} to the list of conditions.

name: Command

duration.entry: until the end of the target's next turn

entries: You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the {@condition fleeing|PC1} condition), release what it's holding, {@action Drop Prone|PC1}, or stand in place. It can't {@action Delay|PC1} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

entries.Success: The creature is unaffected.
entries.Failure: For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.
entries.Critical Failure: The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

5: You can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Confusion
entries: You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.

entries.Success: The target babbles incoherently and is {@condition stunned 1|PC1}.
entries.Failure: The target is {@condition confused|PC1} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.
entries.Critical Failure: The target is {@condition confused|PC1} for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

8: You can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Contingency
entries: You prepare a spell that will trigger later. While casting contingency, you also cast another spell of 4th level or lower with a casting time of no more than 3 actions. This companion spell must be one that can affect you. You must make any decisions for the spell when you cast {@spell contingency|PC1}, such as choosing a damage type for {@spell resist energy|PC1}. During the casting, choose a trigger under which the spell will be cast, using the same restrictions as for the trigger of a {@action Ready|PC1} action. Once contingency is cast, you can cause the companion spell to come into effect as a reaction with that trigger. It affects only you, even if it would affect more creatures. If you define complicated conditions, as determined by the GM, the trigger might fail. If you cast {@spell contingency|PC1} again, the newer casting supersedes the older.

8: You can choose a spell of 5th level or lower.
9: You can choose a spell of 6th level or lower.
10: You can choose a spell of 7th level or lower.

name: Control Water
entries: By imposing your will upon the water, you can raise or lower the level of water in the chosen area by 10 feet. Creatures that have the {@trait water} and that are in the area when you Cast the Spell must attempt a Fortitude save, with the effects of the of {@spell slow|PC1} spell.

name: Cozy Cabin
entries: You shape a cabin 20 feet on each side and 10 feet high. This cabin has the {@trait structure} trait and the same restrictions as magic items that create structures. The walls of the hut are simple and wooden, with small, square glass windows, and it has one wooden door. It doesn't include its own lock, but it has a fastener to which a lock can be applied.

The interior contains three cots, one chamber pot, and a small fireplace holding a magical fire. The interior is lit with a small magical light that you can light or extinguish at will using a single action, which has the {@action Sustain|PC1} action. The climate inside the hut is comfortable and allows creatures inside it to withstand most {@condition hostile|PC1} weather conditions, but incredible heat or cold, powerful storms, and winds of hurricane force or greater destroy the hut. Other creatures can freely enter and exit the hut without damaging it, but if you exit the hut, the spell ends. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} the spell.

name: Create Food
entries: You create enough food to feed six Medium creatures for a day. This food is bland and unappealing, but it is nourishing. After 1 day, if no one has eaten the food, it decays and becomes inedible. Most Small creatures eat one-quarter as much as a Medium creature (one-sixteenth as much for most Tiny creatures), and most Large creatures eat 10 times as much (100 times as much for Huge creatures and so on).

4: You can feed 12 Medium creatures.
6: You can feed 50 Medium creatures.
8: You can feed 200 Medium creatures.

name: Create Water
entries: As you cup your hands, water begins to flow forth from them. You create 2 gallons of water. If no one drinks it, it evaporates after 1 day.

name: Creation
entries: You conjure a temporary object from magical energy. It must consist of earthen or plant-derived matter (such as wood, paper, brick, or stone) and 5 cubic feet or smaller. It can't rely on intricate artistry or complex moving parts, never fulfills a cost or the like, and can't be made of precious materials or materials with a rarity of uncommon or higher. It is obviously temporarily conjured, and thus can't be sold or passed off as a genuine item. The spell gains the appropriate trait for the item created, typically {@trait earth}, {@trait plant}, or {@trait wood}.

5: The item is metal and can include common minerals, like feldspar or quartz. The spell gains the {@trait metal} trait if used to create a metal object

name: Crisis of Faith
entries: You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal {@damage 6d6} mental damage, or {@damage 6d8} mental damage if it can cast divine spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.

entries.Success: The target takes half damage.
entries.Failure: The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's {@condition stupefied 1|PC1} for 1 round.
entries.Critical Failure: The target takes double damage, is {@condition stupefied 1|PC1} for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

entries: To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.

1: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|3-10|2d6} (or by {@scaledamage 6d8|3-10|2d8} if the target is a divine spellcaster).

name: Cursed Metamorphosis
entries: You transform the target creature into a harmless animal appropriate to the area, with effects based on its Fortitude save.

entries.Success: The target's body gains minor features of the harmless animal. Its insides churn as they partially transform, causing it to be {@condition sickened 1|PC1}. When it recovers from the {@condition sickened|PC1} condition, its features revert to normal.
entries.Failure: The target transforms for 1 minute but keeps its mind. If it spends all its actions on its turn concentrating on its original form, it can attempt a Will save to end the effect immediately.
entries.Critical Failure: The target is transformed into the chosen harmless animal, body and mind, for an unlimited duration.

name: Darkness
entries: You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your {@spell darkness|PC1} spell's level or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

4: Even creatures with {@ability darkvision} (but not {@ability darkvision||greater darkvision}) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as {@condition concealed|PC1}.

name: Darkvision
entries: You grant yourself supernatural sight in areas of darkness. You gain {@ability darkvision}.

3: The spell's range is touch and it targets 1 willing creature.
